entries.zh_cn: 缺协方差或残差自由度不足，置信/预测区间不可用；不要仅凭点预测确定最优设置。
entries.en_us: Covariance or residual degrees of freedom are insufficient; confidence/prediction intervals are unavailable—do not set the optimum from the point prediction alone.

entries.zh_cn: DOE 表中没有可用的 P-Value；不能据此宣称因子或交互作用显著。
entries.en_us: The DOE table has no usable P-Value; do not claim factor or interaction significance from it.

entries.zh_cn: 优先在确认性试验中复核显著项，并结合效应方向选择可操作的因子水平；显著性本身不代表工程影响足够大。
entries.en_us: Re-check significant terms in confirmatory trials and choose operable factor levels with effect direction; significance alone does not mean engineering impact is large enough.

entries.zh_cn: 未生成立方图（仅支持 2–3 个因子）；高维设计请结合 Pareto 与主效应/交互图。
entries.en_us: Cube plot was not generated (only 2–3 factors supported); for higher-dimensional designs combine Pareto with main-effect/interaction plots.

entries.zh_cn: 残差图供调查残差形态；直方图不用于证明正态。
entries.en_us: Residual plots are for investigating residual patterns; histograms are not used to prove normality.

entries.zh_cn: 等值线/曲面在编码 [-1,1] 空间求值；非轴因子默认 hold 编码 0，也可按实际单位 hold；二水平模型无平方项，不能把曲面曲率当成已估计。
entries.en_us: Contours/surfaces are evaluated in coded [-1,1] space; non-axis factors default to coded hold 0 (or actual-unit hold); two-level models have no quadratic terms—do not treat surface curvature as estimated.

entries.zh_cn: 检查残差随机性、异常值和重复/纯误差后再确定最优设置；不要仅凭主效应图下结论。
entries.en_us: Check residual randomness, outliers, and replicate/pure error before choosing optimal settings; do not conclude from main-effect plots alone.

entries.zh_cn: 设计矩阵秩亏，回归系数不可解释。
entries.en_us: The design matrix is rank-deficient; regression coefficients are not interpretable.

entries.zh_cn: 未检测到中心点；纯误差估计可能不可用。
entries.en_us: No center points detected; pure-error estimation may be unavailable.

entries.zh_cn: 有纯误差但失拟自由度不足，未给出失拟 F/P。
entries.en_us: Pure error exists but lack-of-fit degrees of freedom are insufficient; LOF F/P was not reported.

entries.zh_cn: 检测到星点超出原始因素范围；需人工确认实验可行性。
entries.en_us: Axial points beyond the original factor ranges were detected; confirm experimental feasibility manually.

entries.zh_cn: 存在不可估计项或误差自由度不足，这些项不输出伪造 F/P。
entries.en_us: Unestimable terms or insufficient error df are present; forged F/P values are not emitted for those terms.

entries.zh_cn: 误差自由度不足，不输出 t、F 与 P。
entries.en_us: Error degrees of freedom are insufficient; t, F, and P are not emitted.

entries.zh_cn: RSM 系数在编码单位；显著不等于已找到工程最优设定。
entries.en_us: RSM coefficients are in coded units; significance does not mean an engineering optimum was found.

entries.zh_cn: 曲面图为静态栅格，不是可旋转交互 3D。
entries.en_us: The surface plot is a static grid, not an interactive rotatable 3D view.

entries.zh_cn: 请结合残差与拟合值/顺序/正态/直方图判断模型充分性。
entries.en_us: Judge model adequacy using residuals with fitted/order/normal/histogram diagnostics together.

entries.zh_cn: 存在负方差分量并已截断为 0；解释时应同时查看原始估计。
entries.en_us: Negative variance components were truncated to 0; review the raw estimates when interpreting.

entries.zh_cn: 按零件图展示各零件重复测量的离散程度；同一零件上点越集中表示重复性越小。该图不单独判定量具是否合格。
entries.en_us: The by-part plot shows within-part repeat scatter; tighter points on a part mean smaller repeatability. The plot alone does not pass/fail the gage.

entries.zh_cn: 将 %Study Var、%Tolerance 和现场公差一起看，不要把单个百分比写成量具合格。
entries.en_us: Read %Study Var, %Tolerance, and field tolerance together; do not write a single percentage as gage pass.

entries.zh_cn: 偏倚/线性表缺少斜率或端点偏倚，不能作完整判定。
entries.en_us: The bias/linearity table lacks slope or endpoint bias; a complete judgment cannot be made.

entries.zh_cn: 将端点偏倚与产品公差和测量系统可接受界限比较；回归关系不能替代跨操作者、跨部件的完整 Gage R&R。
entries.en_us: Compare endpoint bias with product tolerance and MSA acceptance limits; regression does not replace full cross-operator/part Gage R&R.

entries.zh_cn: 按时间顺序回查校准、环境、操作者和量具维护记录；不要在特殊原因未排除前用该量具放行产品。
entries.en_us: Review calibration, environment, operators, and gage maintenance in time order; do not release product with this gage until special causes are cleared.

entries.zh_cn: 评估者×零件图是观察一致率，不是量具通过或已证明一致。
entries.en_us: The appraiser×part plot shows observed agreement rates, not gage pass or proven agreement.

entries.zh_cn: Type 1 表缺少 P 或 Cgk，不能完整评价偏倚与重复性。
entries.en_us: The Type 1 table lacks P or Cgk; bias and repeatability cannot be fully evaluated.

entries.en_us: EMP Crossed: ICC(with interaction) = %1, classification = %2. This is Wheeler monitoring-capability grading, not an AIAG pass/fail decision, and must not be written as gage pass.

entries.zh_cn: Probable Error = %1；用于对照测量增量是否物理合理，不是公差合格证明。
entries.en_us: Probable Error = %1; use it to check whether measurement increments are physically plausible—not proof of tolerance pass.

entries.en_us: ndc = %1; ndc only describes part-to-part variation relative to gage variation discrimination in this study.

entries.en_us: ndc<5 is not an absolute gage-fail conclusion; combine with %Study Var and tolerance risk.

entries.en_us: Total Gage R&R %Study Var = %1; %Contribution and %Study Var use different bases and must not be mixed.

entries.en_us: %Tolerance = %1; decide calibration, repair, or release strategy only after checking product tolerance and risk level.

entries.en_us: Fine-Gray is formula_reference / fine_gray_multi_ipcw (multi-covariate IPCW, mean-centered); not cause-specific Cox, not vendor_oracle; not aligned to pinned R survival::finegray.

entries.zh_cn: 小提琴图：组数 = %1；形状来自分组 KDE，箱线为五数摘要。
entries.en_us: Violin plot: group count = %1; shape comes from grouped KDE; box shows the five-number summary.

entries.zh_cn: 通用条形图：类别数 = %1；未按计数排序，无累积百分比（与柏拉图分流）。

entries.en_us: NIST EDA 4-plot: N = %1; same page includes run sequence, lag-1, histogram, and normal probability. The four plots check location/spread/randomness/distributional-shape assumptions and must not be written as in-control or proven-normal conclusions.

entries.en_us: Cause-and-effect diagram effect is “%1”, with %2 categor(y/ies) and %3 cause(s). This is a structured brainstorming summary, not a statistical test, and must not be written as a proven root cause.

entries.en_us: Turnbull NPMLE (simplified grid); evidence_type=%1; algorithm_id=%2; not right-censored product-limit; nonparametric life model; must not be written as vendor_oracle/golden.

entries.zh_cn: 本批观测均为精确失效（无左/区间/右删失）；仍走区间 NPMLE 路径，不自动等价替换为经典右删失 KM 报告。
entries.en_us: All observations in this batch are exact failures (no left/interval/right censoring); the interval NPMLE path is still used and is not automatically replaced by a classic right-censored KM report.

entries.zh_cn: ACF/PACF 基于 N = %1，最大滞后 = %2；默认置信带方法 = %3%4。越过带宽只提示相对白噪声零假设的相关证据，不能写成过程失控判定。
entries.en_us: ACF/PACF based on N = %1, max lag = %2; default confidence-band method = %3%4. Crossing the band only suggests correlation evidence versus a white-noise null and must not be written as a process out-of-control decision.

entries.zh_cn: 默认带宽是 NIST 白噪声固定 ±z/√n（独立性检验），不是 ARIMA 识别用的 Bartlett 变带宽；亦非 Minitab golden。
entries.en_us: Default bands are NIST white-noise fixed ±z/√n (independence test), not Bartlett variable-width bands for ARIMA identification; also not Minitab golden.

entries.zh_cn: Ljung–Box P ≈ %1；小 P 提示序列存在总体自相关结构，应结合 ACF/PACF 图与工艺时序解释。
entries.en_us: Ljung–Box P ≈ %1; a small P suggests overall serial correlation—interpret with ACF/PACF plots and process timing.

entries.zh_cn: Z-MR 图 N = %1，组数 = %2，Z 图超限 = %3；短流程标准化依赖 %4，超限点需要调查，不能直接当作过程失控或稳定结论。
entries.en_us: Z-MR chart N = %1, groups = %2, Z out-of-control = %3; short-run standardization depends on %4; investigate exceedances—do not treat them as process out-of-control or stability conclusions.

entries.zh_cn: 未提供完整历史 μ/σ 表；本轮用各组样本均值与全序列 MR/d2 估计 σ。
entries.en_us: A complete historical μ/σ table was not provided; this run estimates σ from per-group sample means and overall-series MR/d2.

entries.zh_cn: 移动平均图窗宽 w = %1，「单点超出 3σ 控制限」触发 = %2；MA 平滑后的出限是信号提示，需要结合工艺调查，不能将统计信号直接等同于过程失控判定或稳定结论。
entries.en_us: Moving-average chart window w = %1; '1 point beyond 3σ limits' triggers = %2; MA-smoothed exceedances are signal hints—investigate with process knowledge; do not equate statistical signals with out-of-control or stability conclusions.

entries.zh_cn: 移动平均图与 EWMA 不同；仅完整窗 MA 点参与判读，不是 Minitab golden。
entries.en_us: Moving-average charts differ from EWMA; only complete-window MA points are judged; not Minitab golden.

entries.zh_cn: 运行图 N = %1%2；关于中位数游程 = %3，上升/下降游程 = %4。四模式 P 只提示相对随机性的偏离方向，不能写成已证明过程受控或失控。
entries.en_us: Run chart N = %1%2; runs about median = %3, up/down runs = %4. Four-pattern P-values only hint deviation directions versus randomness and must not be written as proven in-control or out-of-control.

entries.zh_cn: 区域图 Jaehn 累计得分达到阈值 %1 的点有 %2 个；这是统计信号提示，需要调查特殊原因，不能将统计信号直接等同于过程失控判定或稳定结论。
entries.en_us: Zone chart: %2 point(s) reached Jaehn cumulative score threshold %1; this is a statistical signal hint—investigate special causes; do not equate signals with out-of-control or stability conclusions.

entries.zh_cn: 区域图采用 Jaehn 1/2/4 计分（formula_reference），不是完整 Shewhart 特殊原因规则（beyond_control_limit 等）的替代品。
entries.en_us: Zone chart uses Jaehn 1/2/4 scoring (formula_reference) and is not a substitute for full Shewhart special-cause rules (e.g. beyond_control_limit).

entries.en_us: Plackett–Burman: factors = %1, runs = %2, center points = %3. The design matrix is for screening layout only.

entries.en_us: First inspect cells with large mean-panel ranges, then use the SD panel to locate dispersion sources.

entries.en_us: Compare P clustering / mixtures / trends / oscillation with process timing; a small P only indicates evidence of deviation in that pattern direction.
