entries.zh_cn: Johnson 变换后的 Pp/Ppk 是变换尺度上的 overall 指数；未拒绝变换后正态假设不等于原始数据服从正态分布，也不能写成过程合格。
entries.en_us: Johnson-transformed Pp/Ppk are overall indices on the transform scale; failure to reject post-transform normality does not mean the original data are normal and must not be written as process pass.

entries.zh_cn: 非正态 Z-score Pp/Ppk 依赖所选分布的 CDF；拟合未拒绝假设不等于已证明过程服从该分布，也不能写成过程合格。
entries.en_us: Nonnormal Z-score Pp/Ppk depend on the selected distribution CDF; failure to reject the fit does not prove the process follows that distribution and must not be written as process pass.

entries.zh_cn: Johnson 变换 AD P = %1；这是变换尺度上的拟合证据，不是原始数据正态性证明。
entries.en_us: Johnson transform AD P = %1; this is fit evidence on the transform scale, not proof of original-data normality.

entries.zh_cn: 组间/组内能力使用 σ_BW 计算 Cp/Cpk、样本标准差计算 Pp/Ppk；未验证稳定性不等于过程合格。
entries.en_us: Between/within capability uses σ_BW for Cp/Cpk and sample SD for Pp/Ppk; unverified stability is not process pass.

entries.zh_cn: gate_status=%1：当前为研究/预览，证据类型 %2；未满足 golden/尾部验收前不得开放合格判定。
entries.en_us: gate_status=%1: research/preview now; evidence type %2; do not open pass/fail until golden and tail acceptance are satisfied.

entries.zh_cn: gate_status=%1；stability_screen=%2（OOC=%3）；bimodality_screen=%4（peaks=%5）；hartigan_dip=%6（D=%7）；mixture=%8（k=%9，ΔBIC=%10）：I-MR Rule-1 / 直方图双峰 / Hartigan dip / 高斯混合门禁筛查不等于完整稳定性或单峰验收。
entries.en_us: gate_status=%1; stability_screen=%2 (OOC=%3); bimodality_screen=%4 (peaks=%5); hartigan_dip=%6 (D=%7); mixture=%8 (k=%9, ΔBIC=%10): I-MR Rule-1 / histogram bimodality / Hartigan dip / Gaussian-mixture gate screens are not full stability or unimodality acceptance.

entries.zh_cn: 最大类别为“%1”，计数 %2，单项占比 %3%。
entries.en_us: Largest category is “%1”, count %2, item share %3%.

entries.zh_cn: 前 %1 个类别累计占比 %2%；应优先结合现场原因验证，而不是直接假设存在 80/20 规律。
entries.en_us: Top %1 categor(ies) cumulative share %2%; prioritize field cause verification rather than assuming an 80/20 rule.

entries.zh_cn: 若要比较原因频次优先级，请改用柏拉图并结合现场验证。
entries.en_us: To prioritize cause frequencies, use a Pareto chart and validate in the field.

entries.zh_cn: 预测区间反映模型不确定性，不是规格上下限；应通过滚动验证检查不同预测期的稳定性。
entries.en_us: Prediction intervals reflect model uncertainty, not specification limits; check stability across horizons with rolling validation.

entries.zh_cn: 乘法分解要求观测值为正；季节指数与趋势外推对结构变化敏感，应核对残差与移动平均边界。
entries.en_us: Multiplicative decomposition requires positive observations; seasonal indices and trend extrapolation are sensitive to structural change—check residuals and moving-average boundaries.

entries.zh_cn: 加法分解的季节指数与线性趋势外推对结构变化敏感；应核对残差与非等间隔时间诊断。
entries.en_us: Additive decomposition seasonal indices and linear-trend extrapolation are sensitive to structural change; check residuals and irregular-spacing diagnostics.

entries.zh_cn: 未来预测依赖平滑/ARIMA 模型假设；应检查残差、自相关和结构变化，避免外推超出历史范围。
entries.en_us: Future forecasts depend on smoothing/ARIMA assumptions; check residuals, autocorrelation, and structural change—avoid extrapolating beyond the historical range.

entries.zh_cn: 区间图是各组均值的个体置信区间（pooled MSE），不是 Tukey 同时比较。
entries.en_us: The interval plot shows individual mean CIs (pooled MSE), not Tukey simultaneous comparisons.

entries.zh_cn: Grouping Information 使用 %1 个字母；字母来自成对显著矩阵，不改 Studentized Range 近似。
entries.en_us: Grouping Information uses %1 letter(s); letters come from the pairwise-significance matrix and do not change the Studentized Range approximation.

entries.zh_cn: 残差正态或方差齐性检查提供了需要调查的证据，不能把 p 值直接写成工程差异。
entries.en_us: Residual normality or variance-homogeneity checks provide evidence to investigate; do not write p-values directly as engineering differences.

entries.zh_cn: 属性一致性报告观察一致率与 Kappa；≥3 名评估者使用 Fleiss，两两比较仍用 Cohen。
entries.en_us: Attribute agreement reports observed agreement and Kappa; ≥3 appraisers use Fleiss, pairwise comparisons still use Cohen.

entries.zh_cn: 拒绝 Kappa=0 不等于已证明评估者一致；Kappa 只描述超出偶然的绝对一致率。
entries.en_us: Rejecting Kappa=0 does not prove appraiser agreement; Kappa only describes absolute agreement beyond chance.

entries.zh_cn: 有序评级已计算 Kendall 系数；拒绝 W=0 或 τ=0 不等于已证明有序一致。
entries.en_us: Ordinal ratings have Kendall coefficients; rejecting W=0 or τ=0 does not prove ordinal agreement.

entries.zh_cn: 已请求有序评级，但 Kendall 不可识别或等级不足；未伪造 W=1。
entries.en_us: Ordinal ratings were requested, but Kendall is non-identifiable or levels are insufficient; W=1 was not fabricated.

entries.zh_cn: 名义评级看 Kappa；有序评级请设置 ordinal=true 以计算 Kendall W/τ。
entries.en_us: For nominal ratings use Kappa; for ordinal ratings set ordinal=true to compute Kendall W/τ.

entries.zh_cn: 属性一致性缺少 Facts，不能从表头反解析 Kappa 或 Kendall。
entries.en_us: Attribute agreement lacks Facts; Kappa or Kendall must not be reverse-parsed from table headers.

entries.zh_cn: Durbin-Watson = %1，判定区 = %2（按输入顺序与 α=0.05 近似 dL/dU）。不能写成已证明无自相关或存在自相关。
entries.en_us: Durbin-Watson = %1, decision zone = %2 (approximate dL/dU at α=0.05 for the input order). Do not write proven absence or presence of autocorrelation.

entries.zh_cn: I-MR σ 估计方法 = %1%2。σ 估计变化只影响控制限宽度，不能单独写成稳定结论。
entries.en_us: I-MR σ estimation method = %1%2. σ-method changes affect control-limit width only and must not alone be written as a stability conclusion.

entries.zh_cn: 控制限使用了历史 μ/σ；分阶段估计表仅供对照，不会自动改写全局限。
entries.en_us: Control limits use historical μ/σ; the stage-estimate table is for comparison only and does not auto-rewrite global limits.

entries.zh_cn: 已按阶段列汇总估计（阶段数 = %1）；当前输出仍使用全样本估计限，不是逐阶段独立控制图。
entries.en_us: Stage-column estimates summarized (stage count = %1); current output still uses full-sample limits, not independent per-stage charts.

entries.zh_cn: %1：m = %2，p = %3%4，超限 = %5。超限是统计信号提示，需要结合工艺调查，不能单独写成失控或稳定结论。%6
entries.en_us: %1: m = %2, p = %3%4, out-of-control = %5. Exceedances are statistical signal hints—investigate with process knowledge; do not alone write out-of-control or stability conclusions.%6

entries.zh_cn: 本图不是 PCA 经验分位 T²。
entries.en_us: This chart is not PCA empirical-quantile T².

entries.zh_cn: 默认 UCL 可能是渐近近似，不是 ARL 仿真校准。
entries.en_us: Default UCL may be an asymptotic approximation, not ARL simulation calibration.

entries.zh_cn: Montgomery |S| 子组图；个体路径与 NIST 争议说明见诊断。
entries.en_us: Montgomery |S| subgroup chart; see diagnostics for individual-path and NIST controversy notes.

entries.zh_cn: %1 Sigma Z = %2，存在过度离散，传统控制限可能过窄。
entries.en_us: %1 Sigma Z = %2; overdispersion present—traditional control limits may be too narrow.

entries.zh_cn: %1 Sigma Z = %2，控制限已按离散程度进行调整。
entries.en_us: %1 Sigma Z = %2; control limits were adjusted for dispersion.

entries.zh_cn: 存在期望频数过小的类别，卡方近似可能不可靠。
entries.en_us: Some categories have small expected counts; the chi-square approximation may be unreliable.

entries.zh_cn: 存在期望频数过小的单元格，卡方近似可能不可靠。
entries.en_us: Some cells have small expected counts; the chi-square approximation may be unreliable.

entries.zh_cn: 建议合并相邻类别后复算；当前 P 值可作为探索性证据。
entries.en_us: Consider merging adjacent categories and recomputing; the current P-value is exploratory evidence only.

entries.zh_cn: 期望频数过低，建议先调整分组（合并类别）再进行拟合优度检验。
entries.en_us: Expected counts are too low; adjust grouping (merge categories) before goodness-of-fit testing.

entries.zh_cn: 存在期望频数小于 5 的类别，卡方近似可能不可靠。
entries.en_us: Some categories have expected count < 5; the chi-square approximation may be unreliable.

entries.zh_cn: 低期望频数比例偏高，建议合并类别并谨慎解释 P 值。
entries.en_us: A high share of low expected counts; consider merging categories and interpret P-values cautiously.

entries.zh_cn: 期望频数过低，卡方近似可靠性较差。
entries.en_us: Expected counts are too low; the chi-square approximation is poorly supported.

entries.zh_cn: 存在期望频数小于 1 的单元格，卡方近似 P 值不显示。
entries.en_us: Some cells have expected count < 1; chi-square approximate P-values are not shown.

entries.zh_cn: 拟合优度至少需要两个类别，且类别与计数长度相同。
entries.en_us: Goodness-of-fit needs at least two categories, with matching category and count lengths.

entries.zh_cn: 各类观察计数必须为非负有限数，类别名不能为空。
entries.en_us: Observed counts must be finite and non-negative; category names cannot be empty.

entries.zh_cn: 期望比例个数必须与类别个数相同。
entries.en_us: The number of expected proportions must match the number of categories.
Total observed count must be greater than 0.

entries.zh_cn: 期望比例必须为正有限数。
entries.en_us: Expected proportions must be positive and finite.

entries.zh_cn: 列联表至少需要两行两列，且标签数量必须匹配。
entries.en_us: The contingency table needs at least two rows and two columns, with matching label counts.

entries.zh_cn: 列联表每一行必须具有相同列数。
entries.en_us: Each contingency-table row must have the same number of columns.

entries.zh_cn: 列联表单元格必须是非负有限计数。
entries.en_us: Contingency-table cells must be finite, non-negative counts.

entries.zh_cn: 列联表总计数必须大于 0。
entries.en_us: Contingency-table total count must be greater than 0.

entries.zh_cn: 百分比表是描述性结果，不能写成已证明存在或不存在关联。
entries.en_us: Percentage tables are descriptive; do not write them as proof that association exists or does not.

entries.zh_cn: 行%/列%/合计% 是描述性汇总，不替代独立性检验结论。
entries.en_us: Row%/column%/total% are descriptive summaries and do not replace an independence-test conclusion.

entries.zh_cn: 观察频数热图只展示列联表中的计数分布，不能证明因果关系。
entries.en_us: Observed-count heatmaps only show contingency counts; they do not prove causation.

entries.zh_cn: 调整残差热图只描述单元格相对独立假设的偏离方向与相对大小，不是因果证据。
entries.en_us: Adjusted-residual heatmaps only describe cell deviation direction/size versus independence; they are not causal evidence.

entries.zh_cn: Fisher 精确检验%1%2。P 值只描述当前 2×2 表与独立性假设的一致程度，不能写成已证明存在或不存在关联。
entries.en_us: Fisher exact test%1%2. The P-value only describes how well the current 2×2 table matches independence and must not be written as proof that association exists or does not.

entries.zh_cn: Pearson χ²%1%2。P 值只描述当前列联表与独立性假设的一致程度，不能证明因果关系。
entries.en_us: Pearson χ²%1%2. The P-value only describes consistency of the contingency table with independence and does not prove causation.

entries.zh_cn: 最大 |调整残差| = %1%2。这些量只帮助定位偏离，不能写成已证明关联或无关联。
entries.en_us: Largest |adjusted residual| = %1%2. These quantities only help locate deviations and do not prove association or its absence.

entries.zh_cn: 交叉表汇总 %1 × %2 分类，N = %3。本输出只提供频数与百分比，不做独立性检验；检验请使用列联表卡方。
entries.en_us: Cross-tabulation summarizes %1 × %2 categories, N = %3. This output provides counts and percentages only—no independence test; use chi-square association for testing.

entries.zh_cn: 泊松拟合优度 Pearson χ²%1%2，DF = %3%4。P 值只描述观察计数与泊松模型的偏离程度，不能证明总体服从泊松分布。
entries.en_us: Poisson goodness-of-fit Pearson χ²%1%2, DF = %3%4. The P-value only describes deviation of observed counts from a Poisson model and does not prove the population is Poisson.

entries.zh_cn: 拟合优度 Pearson χ²%1%2，DF = %3。P 值只描述观察频数与指定比例的一致程度，不能证明总体比例等于假设。
entries.en_us: Goodness-of-fit Pearson χ²%1%2, DF = %3. The P-value only describes consistency of observed frequencies with specified proportions and does not prove population proportions equal the hypothesis.

entries.zh_cn: 缺失 N* = %1，未进入类别计数。
entries.en_us: Missing N* = %1; these rows are excluded from category counts.

entries.zh_cn: McNemar（Edwards 连续性校正）χ² = %1，配对有效 N = %2，不一致对数 b+c = %3%4。结果只陈述边际比例差异证据，不能写成已证明相同或不同。
entries.en_us: McNemar (Edwards continuity correction) χ² = %1, paired valid N = %2, discordant pairs b+c = %3%4. Results only state evidence of marginal proportion difference and must not be written as proof of sameness or difference.

entries.zh_cn: McNemar 未计算出统计量（非二元、无不一致对或输入不足）。这只说明当前配对表不支持该检验，不能写成前后比例已证明相同或不同。
entries.en_us: McNemar did not compute a statistic (not binary, no discordant pairs, or insufficient input). This only means the paired table does not support the test and must not be written as proof that before/after proportions are the same or different.

entries.zh_cn: McNemar 要求两列配对标签等长且非空。
entries.en_us: McNemar requires two paired label columns of equal, non-empty length.

entries.zh_cn: 存在无法识别为二元水平的标签。
entries.en_us: Some labels could not be recognized as binary levels.

entries.zh_cn: 无不一致对（b+c=0），McNemar 统计量不可计算。
entries.en_us: No discordant pairs (b+c=0); the McNemar statistic cannot be computed.

entries.zh_cn: 二元编码至少需要两列配对标签。
entries.en_us: Binary encoding needs at least two paired label columns.
Paired binary columns must have equal length.

entries.zh_cn: 配对二元要求标签非空。
entries.en_us: Paired binary labels must be non-empty.

entries.zh_cn: 要求合计恰为两个水平，或可识别的二元编码（0/1、pass/fail 等）。
entries.en_us: Labels must total exactly two levels, or use a recognized binary encoding (0/1, pass/fail, etc.).

entries.zh_cn: Cochran Q 要求至少 3 个处理列；两列配对请用 McNemar。
entries.en_us: Cochran Q needs at least three treatment columns; for two paired columns use McNemar.

entries.zh_cn: 处理标签个数必须与列数一致。
entries.en_us: The number of treatment labels must match the number of columns.

entries.zh_cn: Cochran Q 宽表每行处理数必须一致。
entries.en_us: Each Cochran Q wide-format row must have the same number of treatments.

entries.zh_cn: Cochran Q 仅接受已编码的 0/1 值。
entries.en_us: Cochran Q accepts only pre-coded 0/1 values.

entries.zh_cn: 存在全失败或全成功的处理列，解读需谨慎。
entries.en_us: Some treatment columns are all failures or all successes; interpret with caution.

entries.zh_cn: 受试者数 < 4，χ² 近似只作提示。
entries.en_us: Subject count < 4; the χ² approximation is only a hint.

entries.zh_cn: Cochran Q 分母为 0（行和无变异），统计量不可计算。
entries.en_us: Cochran Q denominator is 0 (no row-sum variation); the statistic cannot be computed.
The 2×2 table total count must be greater than 0.

entries.zh_cn: 存在零单元格，优势比未定义（输出 *）。
entries.en_us: Zero cells present; the odds ratio is undefined (reported as *).

entries.zh_cn: 事件数或非事件数小于 5，正态近似可能不准确；请参考 Fisher 精确检验。
entries.en_us: Events or non-events are fewer than 5; the normal approximation may be inaccurate—consult Fisher’s exact test.

entries.zh_cn: 两比例检验要求非零分母，事件数不能超过试验数，且置信水平有效。
entries.en_us: Two-proportion tests require non-zero denominators, events ≤ trials, and a valid confidence level.

entries.zh_cn: 比例标准误为 0，无法计算正态近似检验。
entries.en_us: Proportion standard error is 0; the normal-approximation test cannot be computed.

entries.zh_cn: 假设比例标准误为 0，无法计算正态近似检验。
entries.en_us: Hypothesized-proportion standard error is 0; the normal-approximation test cannot be computed.

entries.zh_cn: 单比例检验要求试验数大于 0，且事件数不能超过试验数。
entries.en_us: One-proportion tests require trials > 0 and events ≤ trials.

entries.zh_cn: 假设比例必须位于 (0, 1) 内。
entries.en_us: The hypothesized proportion must lie in (0, 1).

entries.zh_cn: 假设比例必须在 0 与 1 之间。
entries.en_us: The hypothesized proportion must be between 0 and 1.

entries.zh_cn: 已将多行事件数/试验数求和后再做单比例检验。
entries.en_us: Events/trials from multiple rows were summed before the one-proportion test.

entries.zh_cn: n p0 或 n(1-p0) 小于 5，正态近似可能不准确。
entries.en_us: n·p0 or n·(1−p0) is less than 5; the normal approximation may be inaccurate.

entries.zh_cn: 已将多行缺陷数/观测长度求和后再做单样本泊松率检验。
entries.en_us: Defect counts/exposure lengths from multiple rows were summed before the one-sample Poisson rate test.

entries.zh_cn: 总发生数不大于 10，正态近似可能不准确。
entries.en_us: Total event count is not greater than 10; the normal approximation may be inaccurate.

entries.zh_cn: 两组总发生数不大于 10，正态近似可能不准确。
entries.en_us: Combined event counts across both groups are not greater than 10; the normal approximation may be inaccurate.

entries.zh_cn: 样本量过小，无法计算 McKean–Ryan 置信区间。
entries.en_us: Sample size too small to compute a McKean–Ryan confidence interval.

entries.zh_cn: Mann–Whitney 检验要求两组均有有效观测。
entries.en_us: Mann–Whitney requires valid observations in both groups.

entries.zh_cn: 秩方差为 0，无法计算 Mann–Whitney P 值。
entries.en_us: Rank variance is 0; Mann–Whitney P-value cannot be computed.

entries.zh_cn: 存在样本量小于 10 的组，Mann–Whitney 正态近似只作提示。
entries.en_us: A group has n<10; the Mann–Whitney normal approximation is advisory only.

entries.zh_cn: Wilcoxon signed-rank 检验至少需要两个非零差值。
entries.en_us: Wilcoxon signed-rank needs at least two nonzero differences.

entries.zh_cn: 非零差值少于 10，Wilcoxon 正态近似只作提示。
entries.en_us: Fewer than 10 nonzero differences; Wilcoxon normal approximation is advisory only.

entries.zh_cn: 符号秩方差为 0，无法计算 Wilcoxon P 值。
entries.en_us: Signed-rank variance is 0; Wilcoxon P-value cannot be computed.

entries.zh_cn: Wilcoxon signed-rank 检验要求两列行数相同。
entries.en_us: Wilcoxon signed-rank requires equal-length paired columns.

entries.zh_cn: Kruskal–Wallis 检验至少需要两个且标签匹配的组。
entries.en_us: Kruskal–Wallis needs at least two groups with matching labels.

entries.zh_cn: Kruskal–Wallis 检验需要每个组至少一个有效观测。
entries.en_us: Kruskal–Wallis needs at least one valid observation per group.

entries.zh_cn: 存在少于 5 个观测的组，卡方近似可能不可靠。
entries.en_us: A group has fewer than 5 observations; the chi-square approximation may be unreliable.

entries.zh_cn: Friedman 检验要求响应、处理与区组等长且非空。
entries.en_us: Friedman requires non-empty response, treatment, and block columns of equal length.

entries.zh_cn: Friedman 检验要求数值响应与非空处理/区组标签。
entries.en_us: Friedman requires numeric responses and non-empty treatment/block labels.

entries.zh_cn: Friedman 检验至少需要 2 个处理与 2 个区组。
entries.en_us: Friedman needs at least 2 treatments and 2 blocks.

entries.zh_cn: 同一区组与处理出现重复观测，Friedman 要求每格恰 1 个观测。
entries.en_us: Duplicate observation in a block×treatment cell; Friedman requires exactly one per cell.

entries.zh_cn: 存在缺失的区组×处理组合，Friedman 要求平衡设计。
entries.en_us: Missing block×treatment combination; Friedman requires a balanced design.

entries.zh_cn: 符号检验在丢弃等于假设中位数的观测后无有效符号。
entries.en_us: Sign test has no valid signs after discarding ties at the hypothesized median.

entries.zh_cn: 有效符号数 ≥ 25；主 P 仍为二项精确，正态近似仅作参考。
entries.en_us: Valid signs ≥ 25; the primary P remains exact binomial—normal approximation is reference only.

entries.zh_cn: 中位数置信区间需要至少一个有限观测。
entries.en_us: Median confidence interval needs at least one finite observation.

entries.zh_cn: n<2 时无法计算符号检验中位数置信区间。
entries.en_us: Sign-test median CI cannot be computed when n<2.

entries.zh_cn: 无法构造合法的符号检验中位数置信区间。
entries.en_us: A valid sign-test median confidence interval could not be constructed.

entries.zh_cn: 配对符号检验要求两列等长。
entries.en_us: Paired sign test requires equal-length columns.

entries.zh_cn: Mood 中位数检验至少需要两个且标签匹配的组。
entries.en_us: Mood median test needs at least two groups with matching labels.

entries.zh_cn: 观测数少于 2 的组已从 Mood 检验中排除。
entries.en_us: Groups with fewer than 2 observations were excluded from the Mood test.

entries.zh_cn: 排除小组后不足两个组，无法计算 Mood 中位数检验。
entries.en_us: Fewer than two groups remain after dropping small groups; Mood median test cannot be computed.

entries.zh_cn: Mood 中位数检验有效观测不足。
entries.en_us: Mood median test has insufficient valid observations.

entries.zh_cn: N≤ 或 N> 一侧为 0，Mood χ² 不可计算。
entries.en_us: One side of N≤ or N> is 0; Mood χ² cannot be computed.

entries.zh_cn: 存在期望频数 < 5 的单元格，χ² 近似需谨慎解读。
entries.en_us: Some cells have expected count < 5; interpret the χ² approximation cautiously.

entries.zh_cn: 存在样本量较小的组，Mood χ² 近似只作提示。
entries.en_us: A group has a small sample size; the Mood χ² approximation is advisory only.

entries.zh_cn: 游程检验至少需要 2 个有限观测。
entries.en_us: Runs test needs at least 2 finite observations.

entries.zh_cn: 指定比较准则时必须提供有限的 K。
entries.en_us: A finite K must be provided when a comparison criterion is specified.

entries.zh_cn: 所有观测都在比较准则的同一侧，无法进行游程检验。
entries.en_us: All observations lie on the same side of the criterion; runs test cannot be performed.

entries.zh_cn: 两侧观测少于 10，正态近似可能不稳定。
entries.en_us: Fewer than 10 observations on a side; the normal approximation may be unstable.

entries.zh_cn: Run Chart 需要至少一个有限观测。
entries.en_us: Run Chart needs at least one finite observation.

entries.zh_cn: N < 3，仅输出图形与描述，不出随机性近似 P。
entries.en_us: N < 3: chart and description only—no approximate randomness P.

entries.zh_cn: 全部点落在中位数同一侧，关于中位数的随机性 P 不可用。
entries.en_us: All points lie on one side of the median; median-based randomness P is unavailable.

entries.zh_cn: 存在相邻相等点：按产品锁定计入下行游程（平坦差分归下行）。
entries.en_us: Adjacent equal points present: product lock counts them as down runs (flat diffs as down).

entries.zh_cn: 方差分量原始估计为负，已截断为 0。
entries.en_us: Negative variance-component estimate(s) were truncated to 0.

entries.zh_cn: 公差必须为有限非负数；NaN、无穷或负数不可用。
entries.en_us: Tolerance must be a finite non-negative number; NaN, infinity, or negative values are not allowed.

entries.zh_cn: Gage R&R 要求测量值、零件和操作员列长度一致且至少有四条记录。
entries.en_us: Gage R&R requires measurement, part, and operator columns of equal length with at least four records.

entries.zh_cn: 测量值、零件和操作员标签必须有效。
entries.en_us: Measurements and part/operator labels must be valid.

entries.zh_cn: Crossed Gage R&R 至少需要两个零件和两个操作员。
entries.en_us: Crossed Gage R&R requires at least two parts and two operators.

entries.zh_cn: 每个零件与操作员组合至少需要两次重复测量。
entries.en_us: Each part×operator cell needs at least two replicate measurements.

entries.zh_cn: 每个零件×操作员组合必须具有相同的重复次数。
entries.en_us: Every part×operator cell must have the same number of replicates.

entries.zh_cn: Part×Operator 交互 p>0.25，传统 AIAG 流程可考虑将交互并入重复性；当前结果保留完整交互模型，不自动缩减。
entries.en_us: Part×Operator interaction p>0.25; traditional AIAG practice may pool interaction into repeatability. This result keeps the full interaction model and does not auto-reduce.

entries.zh_cn: ndc<5 只作为调查提示，不是量具不合格的绝对结论。
entries.en_us: ndc<5 is an investigation hint only, not an absolute gage-fail conclusion.

entries.zh_cn: Gage 标准差为 0，ndc 不可估计。
entries.en_us: Gage standard deviation is 0; ndc is not estimable.

entries.zh_cn: 所有测量值相同，无法估计 Gage R&R 方差分量。
entries.en_us: All measurements are identical; Gage R&R variance components cannot be estimated.

entries.zh_cn: 公差必须为有限非负数。
entries.en_us: Tolerance must be a finite non-negative number.

entries.zh_cn: Nested Gage R&R 要求长度一致、至少四条记录。
entries.en_us: Nested Gage R&R requires equal-length columns and at least four records.

entries.zh_cn: Nested Gage R&R 中每个零件必须只属于一个操作员。
entries.en_us: In Nested Gage R&R, each part must belong to only one operator.

entries.zh_cn: Nested Gage R&R 至少需要两个操作员和两个零件。
entries.en_us: Nested Gage R&R requires at least two operators and two parts.

entries.zh_cn: 每个零件至少需要两次重复测量。
entries.en_us: Each part needs at least two replicate measurements.

entries.zh_cn: 每个零件必须具有相同的重复次数。
entries.en_us: Every part must have the same number of replicates.

entries.zh_cn: 每个操作员必须至少有一个零件。
entries.en_us: Each operator must have at least one part.

entries.zh_cn: 每个操作员必须分配相同数量的零件。
entries.en_us: Each operator must be assigned the same number of parts.
ndc<5 is an investigation hint only.

entries.zh_cn: 所有测量值相同，无法估计 Nested Gage R&R 方差分量。
entries.en_us: All measurements are identical; Nested Gage R&R variance components cannot be estimated.

entries.zh_cn: 测量值与因子列长度必须一致。
entries.en_us: Measurement and factor columns must have equal length.

entries.zh_cn: 三因子 Expanded Gage 需要足够观测。
entries.en_us: Three-factor Expanded Gage needs enough observations.

entries.zh_cn: Part、Operator 与附加因子各自至少需要 2 个水平。
entries.en_us: Part, Operator, and the additional factor each need at least 2 levels.

entries.zh_cn: 本轮 Expanded 仅支持完整平衡交叉；缺失格子请用交叉 Gage 或后续 GLM。
entries.en_us: This Expanded path supports only complete balanced crossed designs; for missing cells use crossed Gage or a later GLM.

entries.zh_cn: 各格子重复次数必须相同。
entries.en_us: Every cell must have the same number of replicates.

entries.zh_cn: 重复次数=1：三阶交互用作重复性误差估计。
entries.en_us: Replicates=1: the three-way interaction is used as the repeatability error estimate.

entries.zh_cn: 本命令为平衡三因子随机 Expanded；不平衡/固定效应/嵌套 GLM 仍延后。
entries.en_us: This command is balanced three-factor random Expanded; unbalanced / fixed-effect / nested GLM remains deferred.

entries.zh_cn: Type 1 Gage 至少需要两条有限测量值，参考值和公差必须有效。
entries.en_us: Type 1 Gage requires at least two finite measurements, and the reference and tolerance must be valid.

entries.zh_cn: 重复性为零时 t、p 和置信区间不可用，不输出 p=0。
entries.en_us: When repeatability is zero, t, p, and confidence intervals are unavailable; p=0 is not reported.

entries.zh_cn: Bias/Linearity 要求至少三组且参考值与测量值长度一致。
entries.en_us: Bias/Linearity requires at least three pairs and matching reference and measurement lengths.

entries.zh_cn: 参考值和测量值必须为有限数。
entries.en_us: Reference and measurement values must be finite.

entries.zh_cn: 参考值必须包含至少两个不同水平。
entries.en_us: References must include at least two distinct levels.

entries.zh_cn: 过程变差必须为有限正数（6×过程标准差）。
entries.en_us: Process variation must be a finite positive number (6× process standard deviation).

entries.zh_cn: Stability 至少需要三条测量值。
entries.en_us: Stability requires at least three measurements.

entries.zh_cn: 请选择测量值列，并在配置中提供参考值。
entries.en_us: Select a measurement column and provide a reference value in the configuration.

entries.zh_cn: 没有可用于 Bias/Linearity 的 complete-case 行。
entries.en_us: No complete-case rows are available for Bias/Linearity.

entries.zh_cn: 未提供过程变差（6×过程标准差），Linearity / %Linearity / %Bias 未计算。
entries.en_us: Process variation (6× process SD) was not provided; Linearity / %Linearity / %Bias were not computed.

entries.zh_cn: 请选择评级、部件和评估者列。
entries.en_us: Select rating, part, and appraiser columns.

entries.zh_cn: 加权 Kappa 需要可排序的数值评级；已回退未加权 Cohen。
entries.en_us: Weighted Kappa needs sortable numeric ratings; fell back to unweighted Cohen.

entries.zh_cn: 有序评级必须全部为数值，才能计算 Kendall；未使用字典序。
entries.en_us: Ordinal ratings must all be numeric to compute Kendall; lexicographic order is not used.

entries.zh_cn: Kendall 系数需要至少三个有序等级；当前只输出 Kappa。
entries.en_us: Kendall coefficients need at least three ordinal levels; only Kappa is reported.

entries.zh_cn: 评估者间 Kendall W 不可识别；不伪造 W=1。
entries.en_us: Inter-appraiser Kendall W is not identifiable; W=1 is not fabricated.

entries.zh_cn: 部分零件评级众数平票，对应评估者×零件一致率未计算。
entries.en_us: Some part rating modes are tied; the corresponding appraiser×part agreement rates were not computed.

entries.zh_cn: 未知的 kappa_weight_scheme，已回退为 none。
entries.en_us: Unknown kappa_weight_scheme; fell back to none.

entries.zh_cn: 属性一致性要求列长度一致，标准列为空或与记录数一致，置信度必须在 0 与 1 之间。
entries.en_us: Attribute agreement requires equal column lengths, an empty or matching-length standard column, and confidence in (0, 1).

entries.zh_cn: 项目和评估者标签不能为空。
entries.en_us: Item and appraiser labels cannot be empty.

entries.zh_cn: 属性一致性至少需要两个项目和两个评估者。
entries.en_us: Attribute agreement requires at least two items and two appraisers.

entries.zh_cn: 存在缺失评级；相关配对只使用双方均有评级的项目。
entries.en_us: Missing ratings present; paired comparisons use only items rated by both sides.

entries.zh_cn: 部分项目未被某些评估者评级，评估者间比较将排除这些项目。
entries.en_us: Some items were not rated by every appraiser; inter-appraiser comparisons exclude those items.

entries.zh_cn: 部分项目缺少标准评级，相关评估者-标准比较将排除这些项目。
entries.en_us: Some items lack a standard rating; appraiser-vs-standard comparisons exclude those items.

entries.zh_cn: 评估者重复次数不一致；不等长配对已排除，不会静默截断。
entries.en_us: Appraiser replicate counts differ; unequal-length pairs were excluded without silent truncation.

entries.zh_cn: Fleiss overall Kappa 保持未加权；linear/quadratic 仅用于两两 Cohen。
entries.en_us: Fleiss overall Kappa stays unweighted; linear/quadratic apply only to pairwise Cohen.

entries.zh_cn: 期望一致率 P_expected=1，Kappa 不可识别，不计算无限标准误。
entries.en_us: Expected agreement P_expected=1; Kappa is not identifiable and infinite SE is not computed.

entries.zh_cn: 回归至少需要两个观测、一个响应列和一个预测列。
entries.en_us: Linear regression requires at least two observations, one response column, and one predictor column.

entries.zh_cn: 置信水平必须为 (0,1) 内的有限数。
entries.en_us: Confidence level must be a finite number in (0, 1).

entries.zh_cn: 预测变量数量和标签数量必须有效且一致。
entries.en_us: Predictor count and label count must be valid and match.

entries.zh_cn: 每行预测变量必须具有相同列数。
entries.en_us: Each predictor row must have the same number of columns.

entries.zh_cn: 回归观测数必须不少于参数个数。
entries.en_us: The number of observations must be at least the number of parameters.

entries.zh_cn: 误差自由度 N-p-1 ≤ 0，不输出 t、F 与 P。
entries.en_us: Error degrees of freedom N-p-1 ≤ 0; t, F, and P are not reported.

entries.zh_cn: 响应变量必须全部为有限数值。
entries.en_us: All response values must be finite.

entries.zh_cn: 预测变量必须全部为有限数值。
entries.en_us: All predictor values must be finite.

entries.zh_cn: 设计矩阵存在完全共线或常量预测变量。
entries.en_us: The design matrix has perfect collinearity or a constant predictor.

entries.zh_cn: 设计矩阵秩亏，已拒绝拟合。
entries.en_us: The design matrix is rank-deficient; the fit was rejected.

entries.zh_cn: 秩亏时不要解释系数；先检查常量列或完全共线预测变量。
entries.en_us: Do not interpret coefficients when rank-deficient; first check constant columns or perfectly collinear predictors.

entries.zh_cn: 无法计算回归系数协方差矩阵。
entries.en_us: The regression coefficient covariance matrix could not be computed.

entries.zh_cn: VIF>5 提示共线性调查，不会自动删除预测变量。
entries.en_us: VIF>5 flags a collinearity investigation; predictors are not removed automatically.

entries.zh_cn: 多预测变量回归应同时查看 Seq SS 与 Adj SS；两者不一致常见于不平衡或共线设计。
entries.en_us: For multi-predictor regression, review both Seq SS and Adj SS; differences are common in unbalanced or collinear designs.

entries.zh_cn: Durbin-Watson 临界界不可用（需要 15≤n≤100 且 1≤k'≤5）。
entries.en_us: Durbin–Watson critical bounds are unavailable (requires 15≤n≤100 and 1≤k'≤5).

entries.zh_cn: Durbin-Watson 按输入顺序计算；n 或回归元数超出 α=0.05 界表范围，未给 dL/dU。
entries.en_us: Durbin–Watson is computed in input order; n or number of regressors is outside the α=0.05 bound table, so dL/dU are not provided.

entries.zh_cn: Durbin-Watson 按输入顺序；判定区对照 α=0.05 近似 dL/dU，不能写成已证明无自相关。
entries.en_us: Durbin–Watson uses input order; decision regions use approximate α=0.05 dL/dU and must not be written as proven no autocorrelation.

entries.zh_cn: Anderson-Darling 只能在 alpha 下拒绝或未拒绝残差正态假设。
entries.en_us: Anderson–Darling can only reject or fail to reject residual normality at alpha; it does not prove normality.

entries.zh_cn: 方差齐性主要依据残差对拟合值图，当前不单独给出数值判定。
entries.en_us: Homoscedasticity is assessed mainly from the residual-vs-fitted plot; no separate numeric decision is given.

entries.zh_cn: 增加独立观测或减少模型项后再解释系数显著性。
entries.en_us: Add independent observations or reduce model terms before interpreting coefficient significance.

entries.zh_cn: 误差自由度为正，系数推断可用。
entries.en_us: Error degrees of freedom are positive; coefficient inference is available.

entries.zh_cn: 仍需结合残差图和影响点解释模型。
entries.en_us: Still interpret the model with residual plots and influential points.
The current design matrix is estimable.

entries.zh_cn: 存在删除学生化残差绝对值大于 3 的观测。
entries.en_us: Observations with absolute deleted studentized residual greater than 3 are present.

entries.zh_cn: 没有 |删除学生化残差| > 3 的观测。
存在杠杆值超过 2p/n 的高杠杆点。
entries.en_us: High-leverage points with leverage exceeding 2p/n are present.

entries.zh_cn: Cook's D 或 DFITS 超过常用调查阈值。
entries.en_us: Cook's D or DFITS exceeds a common investigation threshold.

entries.zh_cn: 回查原始行；解释层不会自动删除这些观测。
entries.en_us: Review source rows; the interpretation layer does not delete these observations automatically.

entries.zh_cn: 仍应检查残差图，不能据此宣称没有异常。
entries.en_us: Still check residual plots; do not claim there are no anomalies from this alone.

entries.zh_cn: 高杠杆点需要调查，不自动删除。
entries.en_us: High-leverage points need investigation and are not deleted automatically.

entries.zh_cn: 影响点提示需要调查，解释层不会自动删除这些观测。
entries.en_us: Influential points flag investigation; the interpretation layer does not delete these observations automatically.

entries.zh_cn: 至少一个预测变量 VIF>5。
entries.en_us: At least one predictor has VIF>5.

entries.zh_cn: 未发现 VIF>5 的预测变量。
entries.en_us: No predictor with VIF>5 was found.

entries.zh_cn: VIF>5 只提示共线性调查，不会自动删除变量。
entries.en_us: VIF>5 only flags a collinearity investigation; variables are not removed automatically.

entries.zh_cn: 单因素 ANOVA 至少需要两个有效组。
entries.en_us: One-way ANOVA requires at least two valid groups.

entries.zh_cn: 组标签数量必须与有效组数量一致。
entries.en_us: The number of group labels must match the number of valid groups.

entries.zh_cn: ANOVA 不允许存在没有有效观测的组。
entries.en_us: ANOVA does not allow a group with no valid observations.

entries.zh_cn: 组内误差平方和为 0，无法计算有限 F 统计量。
entries.en_us: Within-group error sum of squares is 0; a finite F statistic cannot be computed.

entries.zh_cn: 误差自由度或组内平方和为 0，不输出伪造 F/P。
entries.en_us: Error degrees of freedom or within-group sum of squares is 0; forged F/P values are not reported.

entries.zh_cn: 增加组内重复或检查是否所有观测完全相同。
entries.en_us: Add within-group replicates or check whether all observations are identical.

entries.zh_cn: ANOVA 残差正态性只能拒绝或未拒绝假设，不能证明组内误差正态。
entries.en_us: ANOVA residual normality can only reject or fail to reject the assumption; it does not prove within-group errors are normal.

entries.zh_cn: Levene 检验只作为方差齐性调查证据，不能单独决定模型是否可用。
entries.en_us: Levene’s test is only investigative evidence for equal variances and alone cannot decide whether the model is usable.

entries.zh_cn: 误差自由度大于 0，F/P 可计算。
entries.en_us: Error degrees of freedom are greater than 0; F/P can be computed.

entries.zh_cn: 总体 F 显著只说明至少一组均值不同，需要多重比较。
entries.en_us: A significant overall F only indicates that at least one group mean differs; multiple comparisons are needed.

entries.zh_cn: Levene 检验提供了组方差不同的证据。
entries.en_us: Levene’s test provides evidence that group variances differ.

entries.zh_cn: 当前 Levene 检验未提供组方差不同的证据。
entries.en_us: The current Levene’s test does not provide evidence that group variances differ.

entries.zh_cn: 方差不齐时应结合图形和非参数替代方法，而不是直接宣称 ANOVA 无效。
entries.en_us: When variances are unequal, combine plots and nonparametric alternatives rather than declaring ANOVA invalid outright.

entries.zh_cn: 两个因子和响应变量必须具有相同且非零的行数。
entries.en_us: Both factors and the response must have the same nonzero number of rows.

entries.zh_cn: 含缺失因子或响应值的观测已从分析中排除。
entries.en_us: Observations with missing factor or response values were excluded from the analysis.

entries.zh_cn: 双因素 ANOVA 需要两个因子各至少两个水平及至少三个观测。
entries.en_us: Two-factor ANOVA requires at least two levels for each factor and at least three observations.

entries.zh_cn: 观测数较少；部分效应可能不可估计或误差自由度不足。
entries.en_us: Few observations; some effects may be non-estimable or error degrees of freedom may be insufficient.

entries.zh_cn: 因子组合存在空单元，交互项可能秩亏。
entries.en_us: Some factor combinations have empty cells; the interaction may be rank-deficient.

entries.zh_cn: 因子组合的重复数不平衡；Seq SS 与 Adj SS 可能不同。
entries.en_us: Factor-combination replicates are unbalanced; Seq SS and Adj SS may differ.

entries.zh_cn: 设计矩阵秩亏；不可估计的项不输出伪造 F/P。
entries.en_us: The design matrix is rank-deficient; non-estimable terms do not report forged F/P values.

entries.zh_cn: 误差自由度为 0，无法计算 F 与 P。
entries.en_us: Error degrees of freedom are 0; F and P cannot be computed.

entries.zh_cn: 双因素 ANOVA 残差来自单元均值；拒绝正态假设只是调查证据。
entries.en_us: Two-factor ANOVA residuals come from cell means; rejecting normality is investigative evidence only.

entries.zh_cn: 单元重复数足够时用 Levene 检验作为方差齐性证据。
entries.en_us: When cell replicates are sufficient, Levene’s test is used as evidence of variance homogeneity.

entries.zh_cn: 单元重复不足，无法计算方差齐性检验。
entries.en_us: Cell replicates are insufficient; a variance-homogeneity test cannot be computed.

entries.zh_cn: 不平衡设计应同时报告 Seq SS 与 Adj SS，不要只看其中一个。
entries.en_us: For unbalanced designs, report both Seq SS and Adj SS; do not rely on only one.

entries.zh_cn: 误差自由度或 MSE 不可用，未输出组均值区间。
entries.en_us: Error degrees of freedom or MSE is unavailable; group-mean intervals were not reported.

entries.zh_cn: 请选择响应变量、因子 A 和因子 B。
entries.en_us: Select a response, factor A, and factor B.

entries.zh_cn: 因子组合不平衡，Sequential SS 与 Adjusted SS 可能不同。
entries.en_us: Factor combinations are unbalanced; Sequential SS and Adjusted SS may differ.

entries.zh_cn: 存在不可估计项或无误差自由度，不输出伪造 F/P。
entries.en_us: Non-estimable terms or no error degrees of freedom are present; forged F/P values are not reported.

entries.zh_cn: 当前效应可估计且误差自由度为正。
entries.en_us: Current effects are estimable and error degrees of freedom are positive.

entries.zh_cn: 不可估计项必须显示原因，不能填入默认 F/P。
entries.en_us: Non-estimable terms must show a reason; default F/P values must not be filled in.

entries.zh_cn: Tukey 比较至少需要两个且标签数量必须匹配的有效组。
entries.en_us: Tukey comparisons require at least two valid groups with matching label counts.

entries.zh_cn: 置信水平必须大于 0 且小于 1。
entries.en_us: Confidence level must be greater than 0 and less than 1.
Tukey comparisons do not allow empty groups.

entries.zh_cn: Tukey 比较不允许无穷或非数值观测。
entries.en_us: Tukey comparisons do not allow infinite or non-numeric observations.

entries.zh_cn: Tukey 比较需要正的组内误差自由度。
entries.en_us: Tukey comparisons require positive within-group error degrees of freedom.

entries.zh_cn: 当前 Tukey 调整使用 Studentized range 的保守 t 分布近似。
entries.en_us: The current Tukey adjustment uses a conservative t-distribution approximation to the studentized range.

entries.zh_cn: 不要把逐比较 alpha 当成家族错误率。
entries.en_us: Do not treat per-comparison alpha as the family-wise error rate.
Generator format must be like D=ABC;E=ABD.

entries.zh_cn: 生成器左侧应为单个因子字母。
entries.en_us: Generator left-hand side must be a single factor letter.

entries.zh_cn: 生成器引用了不存在的因子字母。
entries.en_us: Generator references a factor letter that does not exist.

entries.zh_cn: 生成器右侧乘积无法解析。
entries.en_us: Generator right-hand product could not be parsed.

entries.zh_cn: 生成器右侧不能包含被生成因子。
entries.en_us: Generator right-hand side must not include the generated factor.

entries.zh_cn: 生成器应定义最后 p 个附加因子。
entries.en_us: Generators must define the last p added factors.

entries.zh_cn: 生成器数量必须等于部分析因 p。
entries.en_us: Number of generators must equal fractional factorial p.

entries.zh_cn: 每个附加因子都需要生成器。
entries.en_us: Every added factor requires a generator.

entries.zh_cn: DOE 至少需要一个因子。
entries.en_us: DOE requires at least one factor.
Block count must be greater than zero.

entries.zh_cn: 部分析因 p 必须小于因子数 k。
entries.en_us: Fractional factorial p must be less than factor count k.

entries.zh_cn: 每个 DOE 因子必须有名称、低水平和高水平。
entries.en_us: Each DOE factor must have a name, low level, and high level.

entries.zh_cn: DOE 因子名称必须唯一。
entries.en_us: DOE factor names must be unique.

entries.zh_cn: 该 (k,p) 无内置默认生成器，请在 generators 中手写。
entries.en_us: No built-in default generators for this (k,p); enter generators manually.

entries.zh_cn: 至少需要一个连续因素。
entries.en_us: At least one continuous factor is required.

entries.zh_cn: 因素 ID 必须唯一。
第一阶段只接受连续因素；分类因素不得静默编码。
entries.en_us: Phase 1 accepts continuous factors only; categorical factors must not be silently coded.

entries.zh_cn: 因素低水平必须严格小于高水平。
entries.en_us: Factor low level must be strictly less than high level.

entries.zh_cn: 因素 ID 不能为空。
entries.en_us: Factor ID must not be empty.

entries.zh_cn: 因素低/高水平必须有限。
entries.en_us: Factor low/high levels must be finite.

entries.zh_cn: 中心值必须有限且落在 [low, high] 内。
entries.en_us: Center must be finite and within [low, high].
alpha must be a positive finite number.

entries.zh_cn: 接收数 c 不能大于样本量 n。
entries.en_us: Acceptance number c cannot exceed sample size n.

entries.zh_cn: 批大小 N < n；本轮仍用二项 OC（无限批近似）。
entries.en_us: Lot size N < n; this run still uses binomial OC (infinite-lot approximation).

entries.zh_cn: 各组样本量不等；决策限仍用总 N 近似，解读需谨慎。
entries.en_us: Group sizes are unequal; decision limits still use total-N approximation—interpret with care.

entries.zh_cn: 决策限采用正态/多重比较近似（formula_reference），不是 Minitab exact h 表 golden。
entries.en_us: Decision limits use a normal/multiple-comparison approximation (formula_reference), not a Minitab exact h-table golden.

entries.zh_cn: 泊松拟合优度要求非负整数计数。
entries.en_us: Poisson GOF requires non-negative integer counts.

entries.zh_cn: 至少需要 2 个有效计数。
entries.en_us: At least 2 valid counts are required.

entries.zh_cn: 合并后类别不足，无法计算拟合优度。
entries.en_us: Too few categories after merging; GOF cannot be computed.

entries.zh_cn: 存在期望频数 < 5，卡方近似需谨慎。
entries.en_us: Some expected frequencies are < 5; treat the chi-square approximation with caution.

entries.zh_cn: 有效样本不足以进行 AICc 小样本修正，已返回未修正的 AIC。
entries.en_us: Effective sample size is too small for AICc small-sample correction; uncorrected AIC is returned.

entries.zh_cn: 残差平方和接近零，信息准则使用数值下限稳定计算。
entries.en_us: Residual sum of squares is near zero; information criteria use a numeric floor for stability.

entries.zh_cn: 差分后样本不足以拟合 ARIMA 阶数。
entries.en_us: Differenced sample is insufficient to fit the requested ARIMA order.

entries.zh_cn: AR 拟合失败或设计矩阵秩亏。
entries.en_us: AR fit failed or the design matrix is rank-deficient.

entries.zh_cn: 当前仅支持 AR(p,d,0) 与 MA(0,d,q) 候选，不含混合 ARMA 阶。
entries.en_us: Only AR(p,d,0) and MA(0,d,q) candidates are supported; mixed ARMA orders are not included.

entries.zh_cn: ARIMA 候选要求更多的有限观测值才能拟合。
entries.en_us: More finite observations are required to fit this ARIMA candidate.
Forecast horizon must be greater than zero.

entries.zh_cn: 观测序列必须全部为有限数值。
entries.en_us: All observations in the series must be finite.

entries.zh_cn: 模型计算产生了非有限结果，请检查数据尺度后重试。
entries.en_us: Model computation produced non-finite results; check data scale and retry.

entries.zh_cn: 仅支持 p/q≤3、d≤2 的有限阶 ARIMA。
entries.en_us: Only finite ARIMA orders with p/q≤3 and d≤2 are supported.
ARIMA(0,0,0) is not in the candidate grid.

entries.zh_cn: 混合 ARMA 阶尚未纳入 Best ARIMA 网格。
entries.en_us: Mixed ARMA orders are not yet included in the Best ARIMA grid.

entries.zh_cn: Best ARIMA 候选基于条件最小二乘与差分尺度 AICc；与 Minitab 迭代最小二乘（Meeker TSERIES）的最优阶可能不同。
entries.en_us: Best ARIMA candidates use conditional least squares and differenced-scale AICc; the selected order may differ from Minitab iterative least squares (Meeker TSERIES).

entries.zh_cn: CCD 至少需要 2 个连续因素。
entries.en_us: CCD requires at least 2 continuous factors.

entries.zh_cn: CCC 星点超出原始因素范围；请允许超范围星点，或改用 CCI/CCF。
entries.en_us: CCC axial points exceed original factor ranges; allow beyond-range axials, or use CCI/CCF.

entries.zh_cn: CCC 星点超出原始 low/high；已按允许超范围策略生成，实验可行性需人工确认。
entries.en_us: CCC axial points exceed original low/high; generated under allow-beyond-range policy—experimental feasibility needs human confirmation.

entries.zh_cn: BBD 第一阶段支持 3–7 个连续因素；2 因素不接受。
entries.en_us: Phase-1 BBD supports 3–7 continuous factors; 2 factors are not accepted.

entries.zh_cn: BBD 不包含所有因素同时处于极端水平的角点；这是设计空间边界，不是实现缺陷。
entries.en_us: BBD omits corners where all factors are at extreme levels; this is a design-space boundary, not an implementation defect.

entries.zh_cn: 没有重复运行，无法估计纯误差和失拟。
entries.en_us: No replicate runs; pure error and lack of fit cannot be estimated.

entries.zh_cn: 纯误差占用了全部残差自由度，无法检验失拟。
entries.en_us: Pure error uses all residual degrees of freedom; lack of fit cannot be tested.

entries.zh_cn: 中心点与角点均存在，但没有可用纯误差无法检验曲率。
entries.en_us: Center and corner points are present, but curvature cannot be tested without usable pure error.

entries.zh_cn: 设计没有中心点，未执行曲率检验。
entries.en_us: Design has no center points; curvature test was not performed.

entries.zh_cn: 请选择响应列和至少一个设计因子列。
entries.en_us: Select a response column and at least one design factor column.

entries.zh_cn: 没有可用于响应分析的有效 DOE 运行。
entries.en_us: No valid DOE runs available for response analysis.

entries.zh_cn: 请提供至少一个连续因素。
entries.en_us: Provide at least one continuous factor.

entries.zh_cn: 存在缺少有效因子水平的运行，已跳过。
entries.en_us: Runs missing valid factor levels were skipped.

entries.zh_cn: 已按 PointType/中心水平导入中心点运行，可用于曲率与纯误差。
entries.en_us: Center-point runs were imported via PointType/center levels and can be used for curvature and pure error.

entries.zh_cn: 因子值均在 [-1,1]，按已编码单位拟合 RSM。
entries.en_us: Factor values are already in [-1,1]; fitting RSM in coded units.

entries.zh_cn: 至少一个因子无变异，无法编码。
entries.en_us: At least one factor has no variation and cannot be coded.

entries.zh_cn: 因子已按列内 min/max 线性编码到 [-1,1]。
entries.en_us: Factors were linearly coded to [-1,1] using each column’s min/max.

entries.zh_cn: 设计编码边界与因子数不匹配。
entries.en_us: Design coding bounds do not match the number of factors.

entries.zh_cn: 设计低/高水平必须有限且 low < high。
entries.en_us: Design low/high levels must be finite with low < high.

entries.zh_cn: 设计中心必须落在 [low, high] 内。
entries.en_us: Design center must lie within [low, high].

entries.zh_cn: 因子已按设计 low/high/center 编码（与 CCD/BBD 一致）。
entries.en_us: Factors were coded with design low/high/center (consistent with CCD/BBD).

entries.zh_cn: RSM 需要响应与因子行数一致，且至少两个因子。
entries.en_us: RSM requires matching response and factor row counts and at least two factors.

entries.zh_cn: 每行因子列数必须一致。
entries.en_us: Each row must have the same number of factor columns.

entries.zh_cn: 检测到重复编码点，已用于纯误差 / 失拟估计。
entries.en_us: Replicated coded points detected; used for pure-error / lack-of-fit estimation.

entries.zh_cn: 没有重复编码点，无法估计纯误差和失拟；不得用残差 MS 冒充纯误差。
entries.en_us: No replicated coded points; cannot estimate pure error or lack of fit—do not present residual MS as pure error.

entries.zh_cn: 失拟 ANOVA 证据类型 formula_reference；不是 vendor_oracle。
entries.en_us: Lack-of-fit ANOVA evidence_type is formula_reference; not vendor_oracle.

entries.zh_cn: 纯误差自由度大于残差自由度，跳过失拟分解（可能模型过参或重复点过多）。
entries.en_us: Pure-error DF exceeds residual DF; skipping lack-of-fit decomposition (possible over-parameterization or excess replicates).

entries.zh_cn: 等值线需要两个不同因子且模型已拟合。
entries.en_us: Contours require two distinct factors and a fitted model.

entries.zh_cn: 寿命和删失指示列长度必须一致且至少包含两条记录。
entries.en_us: Lifetime and censoring indicator columns must have equal length and at least two records.
Lifetime values must be finite and positive.

entries.zh_cn: 全为删失，无法识别 Weibull 参数。
entries.en_us: All observations are censored; Weibull parameters are not identifiable.

entries.zh_cn: 只有一条失效记录时 Weibull 形状参数通常不可稳定识别。
entries.en_us: With only one failure, the Weibull shape is usually not stably identifiable.

entries.zh_cn: 失效时间没有足够变化，无法有限地识别 Weibull 形状。
entries.en_us: Failure times lack enough variation to identify a finite Weibull shape.

entries.zh_cn: 置信水平必须在 0 和 1 之间。
entries.en_us: Confidence level must be between 0 and 1.

entries.zh_cn: 全为删失，无法识别失效分布或中位寿命。
entries.en_us: All observations are censored; failure distribution and median life are not identifiable.

entries.zh_cn: 最大观测为删失，尾部生存函数不可估计到 0。
entries.en_us: The largest observation is censored; the survival curve may not reach 0 in the tail.

entries.zh_cn: Log-rank 检验要求寿命、事件和分组列长度一致。
entries.en_us: Log-rank requires equal-length lifetime, event, and group columns.

entries.zh_cn: Log-rank 时间必须为正数，分组必须编码为 0 或 1。
entries.en_us: Log-rank times must be positive and groups must be coded 0 or 1.

entries.zh_cn: Log-rank 检验至少需要两个非空分组。
entries.en_us: Log-rank requires at least two non-empty groups.

entries.zh_cn: 分组失效模式没有可估计的 Log-rank 方差。
entries.en_us: Group failure pattern yields no estimable Log-rank variance.

entries.zh_cn: 三参数 Weibull 至少需要三次失效才能识别阈值。
entries.en_us: Three-parameter Weibull needs at least three failures to identify the threshold.

entries.zh_cn: 失效时间没有足够变化，无法识别三参数 Weibull。
entries.en_us: Failure times lack enough variation to identify three-parameter Weibull.

entries.zh_cn: 三参数 Weibull 似然无界（常见于形状 ≤ 1）；不估计阈值，也不伪造参数。
entries.en_us: Three-parameter Weibull likelihood is unbounded (often when shape ≤ 1); threshold is not estimated and parameters are not invented.

entries.zh_cn: 未能找到形状大于 1 的有限三参数 Weibull 估计。
entries.en_us: No finite three-parameter Weibull estimate with shape > 1 was found.

entries.zh_cn: 指数模型至少需要一条失效记录。
entries.en_us: The exponential model requires at least one failure.

entries.zh_cn: 两参数指数至少需要一条失效记录。
entries.en_us: Two-parameter exponential requires at least one failure.

entries.zh_cn: 失效时间没有足够变化，两参数指数似然无界；不估计阈值，也不伪造参数。
entries.en_us: Failure times lack enough variation; two-parameter exponential likelihood is unbounded—threshold is not estimated and parameters are not invented.

entries.zh_cn: 两参数指数未能找到有限阈值估计；不伪造参数。
entries.en_us: Two-parameter exponential found no finite threshold estimate; parameters are not invented.

entries.zh_cn: 全为删失，无法识别对数正态参数。
entries.en_us: All observations are censored; lognormal parameters are not identifiable.

entries.zh_cn: 只有一条失效记录时对数正态尺度通常不可稳定识别。
entries.en_us: With only one failure, the lognormal scale is usually not stably identifiable.

entries.zh_cn: 三参数对数正态至少需要两次失效才能识别阈值。
entries.en_us: Three-parameter lognormal needs at least two failures to identify the threshold.

entries.zh_cn: 失效时间没有足够变化，三参数对数正态似然无界；不估计阈值，也不伪造参数。
entries.en_us: Failure times lack enough variation; three-parameter lognormal likelihood is unbounded—threshold is not estimated and parameters are not invented.

entries.zh_cn: 三参数对数正态似然无界；不估计阈值，也不伪造参数。
entries.en_us: Three-parameter lognormal likelihood is unbounded; threshold is not estimated and parameters are not invented.

entries.zh_cn: 未能找到有限的三参数对数正态估计。
entries.en_us: No finite three-parameter lognormal estimate was found.

entries.zh_cn: Hosmer–Lemeshow 在样本量不足、未收敛或完全分离时不计算。
entries.en_us: Hosmer–Lemeshow is not computed when the sample is too small, the fit did not converge, or complete separation is present.

entries.zh_cn: Hosmer–Lemeshow 分组期望方差过小，检验不可用。
entries.en_us: Hosmer–Lemeshow group expected variance is too small; the test is unavailable.

entries.zh_cn: Hosmer–Lemeshow 有效组数不足，检验不可用。
entries.en_us: Too few usable Hosmer–Lemeshow groups; the test is unavailable.

entries.zh_cn: 二元 Logistic 回归至少需要三个观测和一个预测变量。
entries.en_us: Binary logistic regression requires at least three observations and one predictor.

entries.zh_cn: 置信水平、收敛容差和最大迭代次数必须有效。
entries.en_us: Confidence level, convergence tolerance, and maximum iterations must be valid.

entries.zh_cn: 预测变量标签数量必须与预测变量列数一致。
entries.en_us: The number of predictor labels must match the number of predictor columns.

entries.zh_cn: 响应变量必须全部为 0 或 1。
entries.en_us: All response values must be 0 or 1.

entries.zh_cn: Logistic 回归需要多于参数数量的观测。
entries.en_us: Logistic regression requires more observations than parameters.

entries.zh_cn: Logistic 信息矩阵秩亏，无法进行 IRLS 更新。
entries.en_us: The logistic information matrix is rank-deficient; IRLS cannot update.

entries.zh_cn: 线性预测量达到数值稳定性边界，概率已进行安全截断。
entries.en_us: The linear predictor reached a numeric stability bound; probabilities were safely clipped.

entries.zh_cn: IRLS 在最大迭代次数内未达到收敛容差。
entries.en_us: IRLS did not reach the convergence tolerance within the maximum iterations.

entries.zh_cn: 预测变量完全分离了 0/1 响应，极大似然估计可能不存在。
entries.en_us: Predictors completely separate the 0/1 response; the MLE may not exist.

entries.zh_cn: 预测概率达到边界，模型可能存在准分离。
entries.en_us: Predicted probabilities reached the boundary; the model may have quasi-separation.

entries.zh_cn: 无法计算 Logistic 系数协方差矩阵。
entries.en_us: Unable to compute the logistic coefficient covariance matrix.

entries.zh_cn: Poisson 回归至少需要三个观测和一个预测变量。
entries.en_us: Poisson regression requires at least three observations and one predictor.

entries.zh_cn: 响应必须为非负有限值，且预测矩阵规整。
entries.en_us: Responses must be non-negative and finite, and the predictor matrix must be well-formed.
The IRLS information matrix is singular.

entries.zh_cn: 逐步回归需要 ≥4 观测与 ≥2 候选预测变量。
entries.en_us: Stepwise regression requires ≥4 observations and ≥2 candidate predictors.

entries.zh_cn: α_remove < α_enter 可能导致振荡；仍继续。
entries.en_us: α_remove < α_enter may cause oscillation; continuing anyway.

entries.zh_cn: 未选入任何预测变量（仅截距）。
有序 Logistic 需要 ≥10 观测、≥3 有序水平与 ≥1 预测变量。
entries.en_us: Ordinal logistic requires ≥10 observations, ≥3 ordered levels, and ≥1 predictor.
Response category code is out of range.

entries.zh_cn: 有序 Logistic 信息矩阵奇异。
entries.en_us: The ordinal logistic information matrix is singular.

entries.zh_cn: 检测到 1 点超出 3σ 控制限，建议复核该观测、测量和记录过程。
entries.en_us: Detected 1 point beyond the 3σ control limits; review that observation, the measurement, and the recording process.

entries.zh_cn: 检测到连续 9 点位于中心线同侧，建议复核阶段、设备或批次因素。
entries.en_us: Detected 9 consecutive points on the same side of the center line; review stage, equipment, or batch factors.

entries.zh_cn: 检测到连续 6 点单调上升或下降，建议复核趋势、刀具磨损或过程漂移。
entries.en_us: Detected 6 consecutive points rising or falling monotonically; review trend, tool wear, or process drift.

entries.zh_cn: 检测到连续 14 点上下交替，建议复核系统性周期或两台设备交替影响。
entries.en_us: Detected 14 consecutive points alternating up and down; review systematic cycles or alternating equipment effects.

entries.zh_cn: 检测到 3 点中有 2 点同侧超过 2σ，提示可能存在较小的过程偏移。
entries.en_us: Detected 2 of 3 points on the same side beyond 2σ, suggesting a possible small process shift.

entries.zh_cn: 检测到 5 点中有 4 点同侧超过 1σ，提示可能存在较小的过程偏移。
entries.en_us: Detected 4 of 5 points on the same side beyond 1σ, suggesting a possible small process shift.

entries.zh_cn: 检测到连续 15 点落在 1σ 以内，控制限可能过宽或数据存在分层。
entries.en_us: Detected 15 consecutive points within 1σ; control limits may be too wide or the data may be stratified.

entries.zh_cn: 检测到连续 8 点落在 1σ 以外，提示可能存在混合总体或双群模式。
entries.en_us: Detected 8 consecutive points outside 1σ, suggesting a possible mixed population or bimodal pattern.

entries.zh_cn: I-MR 不允许 NaN 或无穷观测。
entries.en_us: I-MR does not allow NaN or infinite observations.

entries.zh_cn: MSSD 需要至少一对相继差分。
entries.en_us: MSSD requires at least one successive difference pair.

entries.zh_cn: MSSD 无偏常数 c4' 使用近似式，不是完整 Minitab 表查表。
entries.en_us: The MSSD unbiased constant c4' uses an approximation, not a full Minitab table lookup.

entries.zh_cn: Nelson estimate 仅适用于平均移动极差法；当前 MSSD 方法已忽略该选项。
entries.en_us: Nelson estimate applies only to average moving range; the current MSSD method ignored that option.

entries.zh_cn: Nelson estimate 剔除后无剩余移动极差，回退到未剔除估计。
entries.en_us: After Nelson estimate exclusions, no moving ranges remained; fell back to the untrimmed estimate.

entries.zh_cn: Nelson estimate 仅适用于平均移动极差法；当前方法已忽略该选项。
entries.en_us: Nelson estimate applies only to average moving range; the current method ignored that option.

entries.zh_cn: Xbar-R 要求各组样本量相等，不能用最后一组的 d2/A2 代替。
entries.en_us: Xbar-R requires equal subgroup sizes; d2/A2 from the last subgroup cannot be substituted.

entries.zh_cn: Xbar-R 子组不允许 NaN 或无穷观测。
entries.en_us: Xbar-R subgroups do not allow NaN or infinite observations.

entries.zh_cn: I-MR-R/S 至少需要两个子组。
entries.en_us: I-MR-R/S requires at least two subgroups.

entries.zh_cn: 各子组必须至少包含两个观测。
entries.en_us: Each subgroup must contain at least two observations.

entries.zh_cn: I-MR-R/S 子组不允许 NaN 或无穷观测。
entries.en_us: I-MR-R/S subgroups do not allow NaN or infinite observations.

entries.zh_cn: 无法计算 I-MR-R/S 控制图。
估计的组间方差为负，已截断为 0；σ_B 可能低估。
entries.en_us: Estimated between-subgroup variance was negative and truncated to 0; σ_B may be understated.

entries.zh_cn: EWMA 要求非空数据、lambda 位于 (0,1] 且控制限倍数大于 0。
entries.en_us: EWMA requires non-empty data, lambda in (0,1], and a control-limit multiplier greater than 0.

entries.zh_cn: EWMA 的过程标准差必须大于 0。
entries.en_us: EWMA process standard deviation must be greater than 0.

entries.zh_cn: CUSUM 要求非空数据、sigma/h 大于 0 且 k 不小于 0。
entries.en_us: CUSUM requires non-empty data, sigma/h greater than 0, and k not less than 0.

entries.zh_cn: 区域图至少需要 2 个观测。
entries.en_us: The zone chart requires at least 2 observations.

entries.zh_cn: 区域图不允许非有限观测。
entries.en_us: The zone chart does not allow non-finite observations.

entries.zh_cn: 无法估计过程 σ（移动极差）。
entries.en_us: Unable to estimate process σ (moving range).

entries.zh_cn: 过程 σ 必须大于 0。
entries.en_us: Process σ must be greater than 0.

entries.zh_cn: Z-MR 至少需要 2 个观测。
Z-MR 不允许非有限观测。
entries.en_us: Z-MR does not allow non-finite observations.

entries.zh_cn: 移动平均图不允许非有限观测。
entries.en_us: Moving-average chart does not allow non-finite observations.

entries.zh_cn: 移动平均图需要至少 w 个观测。
entries.en_us: Moving-average chart requires at least w observations.

entries.zh_cn: σ 与控制限倍数必须大于 0。
entries.en_us: σ and the control-limit multiple must be greater than 0.

entries.zh_cn: 组内 σ 至少需要两个子组。
entries.en_us: Within-subgroup σ requires at least two subgroups.

entries.zh_cn: 各子组必须具有相同观测数。
entries.en_us: All subgroups must have the same number of observations.

entries.zh_cn: 子组不允许 NaN 或无穷观测。
entries.en_us: Subgroups must not contain NaN or infinite observations.

entries.zh_cn: 子组大小超出无偏常数表范围。
entries.en_us: Subgroup size is outside the unbiased-constant table range.

entries.zh_cn: 无法计算该子组大小的 c4。
entries.en_us: Unable to compute c4 for this subgroup size.

entries.zh_cn: G 图至少需要两个有限间隔。
entries.en_us: G chart requires at least two finite intervals.

entries.zh_cn: G 图间隔必须为非负有限数。
entries.en_us: G-chart intervals must be non-negative and finite.

entries.zh_cn: 无法从间隔均值估计几何分布参数 p。
entries.en_us: Unable to estimate geometric parameter p from interval mean.

entries.zh_cn: T 图间隔必须为非负有限数。
entries.en_us: T-chart intervals must be non-negative and finite.

entries.zh_cn: T 图至少需要两个正间隔。
entries.en_us: T chart requires at least two positive intervals.

entries.zh_cn: Weibull 参数无法识别，T 图控制限未计算。
entries.en_us: Weibull parameters not identifiable; T-chart control limits not computed.

entries.zh_cn: 存在 0 间隔，已排除后用 log-log 回归估计 Weibull 参数。
entries.en_us: Zero intervals present; excluded and Weibull parameters estimated via log-log regression.

entries.zh_cn: 0 间隔回归无法估计 Weibull 参数。
entries.en_us: Zero-interval regression could not estimate Weibull parameters.

entries.zh_cn: 0 间隔回归得到非正形状参数。
entries.en_us: Zero-interval regression yielded a non-positive shape parameter.

entries.zh_cn: Nelson estimate 剔除了 %1 个过大移动极差后重估 σ。
entries.en_us: Nelson estimate excluded %1 oversized moving range(s) and re-estimated σ.
LSL must be a finite number.
USL must be a finite number.

entries.zh_cn: 过程均值必须为有限数。
entries.en_us: Process mean must be a finite number.

entries.zh_cn: 组间/组内能力需要有效数值观测。
entries.en_us: Between/within capability requires valid numeric observations.
ANOM requires at least two groups.

entries.zh_cn: 每组至少需要 2 个观测。
entries.en_us: Each group requires at least 2 observations.

entries.zh_cn: 区域得分采用 Jaehn 1/2/4 权重、累计阈值 8（formula_reference），不是 Minitab 自定义权重 golden。
entries.en_us: Zone scores use Jaehn 1/2/4 weights with cumulative threshold 8 (formula_reference), not Minitab custom-weight golden.

entries.zh_cn: 未提供完整历史 μ/σ；本轮用各组样本均值与全序列 MR/d2 估计 σ。
entries.en_us: Complete historical μ/σ were not provided; this run estimates σ from each group's sample mean and the full-series MR/d2.

entries.zh_cn: CUSUM 不使用 Shewhart 特殊原因规则（beyond_control_limit 等），改用上/下侧累计和首次信号。
entries.en_us: CUSUM does not use Shewhart special-cause rules (beyond_control_limit, etc.); it uses first signals from the upper/lower cumulative sums instead.

entries.zh_cn: 删失工作表需要 censoring_type 与 time 列。
entries.en_us: Censoring worksheet requires censoring_type and time columns.

entries.zh_cn: interval 行需要 interval_left / interval_right 列。
entries.en_us: Interval rows require interval_left / interval_right columns.

entries.zh_cn: 删失契约至少需要一条观测。
entries.en_us: Censoring contract requires at least one observation.

entries.zh_cn: 时间必须为有限非负数；负时间阻止分析。
entries.en_us: Time must be finite and non-negative; negative time blocks analysis.

entries.zh_cn: 出现时间为 0 的失效；请确认单位与记录口径。
entries.en_us: A failure at time 0 was found; confirm units and recording convention.

entries.zh_cn: 区间删失边界必须为有限非负数。
entries.en_us: Interval-censoring bounds must be finite and non-negative.

entries.zh_cn: 区间删失要求左端严格小于右端；反向区间阻止。
entries.en_us: Interval censoring requires left bound strictly less than right; reversed intervals are blocked.

entries.zh_cn: 暴露量必须为有限非负数。
entries.en_us: Exposure must be finite and non-negative.

entries.zh_cn: 观测时间单位不一致，阻止合并分析。
entries.en_us: Observation time units disagree; pooled analysis is blocked.

entries.zh_cn: 零失效（全删失或无 exact 事件）；生存/参数估计可能不可识别。
entries.en_us: Zero failures (all censored or no exact events); survival/parameter estimates may be unidentifiable.

entries.zh_cn: 全部为失效事件，无删失。
entries.en_us: All events are failures; no censoring.

entries.zh_cn: 全部删失；中位寿命等点估计通常不可得。
entries.en_us: All observations are censored; point estimates such as median life are usually unavailable.

entries.zh_cn: 删失契约证据类型 formula_reference；右删失不得当作失效。
entries.en_us: Censoring-contract evidence type is formula_reference; right-censored times must not be treated as failures.

entries.zh_cn: 保修窗口 T_w 必须为正有限数。
entries.en_us: Warranty window T_w must be a positive finite number.

entries.zh_cn: 保修摘要需要明确时间单位。
entries.en_us: Warranty summary requires an explicit time unit.

entries.zh_cn: 输入为全删失；预测摘要仍可计算，但不得宣称为观察失效率。
entries.en_us: Input is fully censored; a prediction summary can still be computed but must not be labeled as an observed failure rate.
claims/1000 = 1000*(1-R(T_w)); evidence type formula_reference, not vendor_oracle.

entries.zh_cn: 当前摘要标记为 prediction，不得与观察失效计数混读为同一口径。
entries.en_us: This summary is labeled prediction and must not be read as the same quantity as observed failure counts.

entries.zh_cn: 部分 failure_mode 层使用 cause-specific R(T_w)，其余仍用池化 R；证据类型 formula_reference，不是 vendor_oracle。
entries.en_us: Some failure_mode strata use cause-specific R(T_w); others still use pooled R; evidence type formula_reference, not vendor_oracle.

entries.zh_cn: 分层 expected_failures = 层暴露量 * F_mode(T_w)，F_mode 来自 cause-specific 分模式拟合（竞争失效作右删失）；formula_reference，不是 vendor_oracle。
entries.en_us: Stratum expected_failures = stratum exposure * F_mode(T_w), where F_mode comes from cause-specific per-mode fits (competing failures as right-censored); formula_reference, not vendor_oracle.

entries.zh_cn: 分模式拟合当前仅支持二参数 Weibull / Lognormal / Exponential / KM；阈值模型请用总体拟合。
entries.en_us: Per-mode fitting currently supports two-parameter Weibull / Lognormal / Exponential / KM only; use overall fitting for threshold models.

entries.zh_cn: 无带 failure_mode 标签的 exact 失效，跳过分模式拟合。
entries.en_us: No exact failures labeled with failure_mode; per-mode fitting skipped.

entries.zh_cn: 分模式可靠度 = cause-specific：目标模式 exact 为失效，其他已标注模式的 exact 作为右删失，原始 right 仍为右删失；evidence_type=formula_reference，algorithm_id=cause_specific_right_censored_competing；不是 vendor_oracle。
entries.en_us: Per-mode reliability is cause-specific: target-mode exact events are failures; other labeled-mode exact events are right-censored; original right remains right-censored; evidence_type=formula_reference, algorithm_id=cause_specific_right_censored_competing; not vendor_oracle.

entries.zh_cn: 事件列只接受明确的失效/删失编码；未知值不会被静默当作删失。
entries.en_us: The event column accepts only explicit failure/censoring codes; unknown values are not silently treated as censored.

entries.zh_cn: 删失类型列无法解析，或与事件列冲突；未知值不会被静默改写。left/interval 若出现在数据中，将由删失契约拒绝经典 KM 路径。
entries.en_us: Censoring-type column could not be parsed or conflicts with the event column; unknown values are not silently rewritten. If left/interval appear, the censoring contract rejects the classic KM path.

entries.zh_cn: 需要至少一行多元观测。
entries.en_us: At least one multivariate observation row is required.

entries.zh_cn: Hotelling T² 至少需要两个变量列。
entries.en_us: Hotelling T² requires at least two variable columns.

entries.zh_cn: 个体 T² Phase I 需要 m > p+1。
entries.en_us: Individuals T² Phase I requires m > p+1.

entries.zh_cn: source_rows 长度必须匹配观测数。
entries.en_us: source_rows length must match the number of observations.

entries.zh_cn: 无法估计均值/协方差（非有限或不矩形）。
entries.en_us: Unable to estimate mean/covariance (non-finite or non-rectangular).

entries.zh_cn: 样本协方差奇异，无法计算 T²。
entries.en_us: Sample covariance is singular; T² cannot be computed.

entries.zh_cn: 本命令是正式多元 Hotelling T² 控制图，不是 PCA 经验分位 T²。
entries.en_us: This command is a formal multivariate Hotelling T² control chart, not PCA empirical-quantile T².

entries.zh_cn: MEWMA 至少需要两个变量列。
entries.en_us: MEWMA requires at least two variable columns.

entries.zh_cn: MEWMA 至少需要 3 个观测。

entries.en_us: The observation matrix must be rectangular.

entries.zh_cn: MEWMA 协方差在当前步奇异。
entries.en_us: MEWMA covariance is singular at the current step.

entries.zh_cn: 默认 UCL 使用渐近 χ² 近似，不是仿真 ARL 校准常数；可手工指定 ucl。
entries.en_us: Default UCL uses an asymptotic χ² approximation, not a simulation ARL-calibrated constant; you may specify ucl manually.

entries.zh_cn: MEWMA 是多元向量平滑；不要与单变量 EWMA 图混淆。
entries.en_us: MEWMA is multivariate vector smoothing; do not confuse it with a univariate EWMA chart.
At least one subgroup is required.

entries.zh_cn: GV 图至少需要两个变量。
entries.en_us: The GV chart requires at least two variables.

entries.zh_cn: 广义方差图要求每个子组大小 n > 变量数 p。
entries.en_us: Generalized variance requires each subgroup size n > number of variables p.

entries.zh_cn: 广义方差图要求等量子组。
子组观测必须具有相同变量数。
entries.en_us: Subgroup observations must have the same number of variables.

entries.zh_cn: 广义方差图按 Montgomery |S| 子组公式；个体观测路径不做假 |S|。
entries.en_us: Generalized variance follows Montgomery |S| subgroup formulas; the individuals path does not fabricate |S|.

entries.zh_cn: NIST 指出多元变差图存在争议；本输出仅作 |S| 探索信号，不是唯一变差判定。
entries.en_us: NIST notes multivariate variability charts are controversial; this output is an exploratory |S| signal only, not a sole variability decision.

entries.zh_cn: 重复性方差为 0，Probable Error 为 0；请检查设计。
entries.en_us: Repeatability variance is 0, so Probable Error is 0; check the design.

entries.zh_cn: EMP 分级基于 Wheeler ICC，不是 AIAG %Study Var 合格判定。
entries.en_us: EMP classification is based on Wheeler ICC, not an AIAG %Study Var pass/fail decision.

entries.zh_cn: 无带 failure_mode 标签的 exact 失效，跳过 Aalen–Johansen CIF。
entries.en_us: No exact failures with a failure_mode label; skipping Aalen–Johansen CIF.

entries.zh_cn: 累计发生函数 CIF = Aalen–Johansen（formula_reference / aalen_johansen_cif）：总体生存把任一标注失效当作事件；CIF_k 为原因 k 的累计发生概率。不是 Fine-Gray 多协变量回归，不是 cause-specific（竞争删失）可靠度，不是 vendor_oracle。二分类 group 的 Fine-Gray 另有门禁路径。
entries.en_us: CIF = Aalen–Johansen (formula_reference / aalen_johansen_cif): overall survival treats any labeled failure as an event; CIF_k is the cumulative incidence for cause k. Not Fine-Gray multivariable regression, not cause-specific (competing-censor) reliability, and not vendor_oracle. Binary-group Fine-Gray has a separate gated path.

entries.zh_cn: Aalen–Johansen CIF 本身不是 Fine-Gray 回归；不得把 CIF 表写成 Fine-Gray 或商业软件对齐。
entries.en_us: Aalen–Johansen CIF is not Fine-Gray regression; do not present the CIF table as Fine-Gray or commercial-software alignment.

entries.zh_cn: 不得把本 Fine-Gray 结果写成商业软件对齐或 pinned R survival::finegray 黄金标准。
entries.en_us: Do not present these Fine-Gray results as commercial-software alignment or a pinned R survival::finegray golden standard.

entries.zh_cn: Fine-Gray 信息量退化，未能估计 β。
entries.en_us: Fine-Gray information matrix is singular; β could not be estimated.

entries.zh_cn: Fine-Gray 未在迭代上限内收敛。
entries.en_us: Fine-Gray did not converge within the iteration limit.

entries.zh_cn: Fine-Gray 信息量不可逆，未能估计 SE。
entries.en_us: Fine-Gray information matrix is not invertible; SE could not be estimated.

entries.zh_cn: Fine-Gray 协变量矩阵行数与观测不一致。
entries.en_us: Fine-Gray covariate matrix row count does not match the observation count.

entries.zh_cn: Fine-Gray 需要带 failure_mode 的 exact 失效。
entries.en_us: Fine-Gray requires exact failures that carry a failure_mode.

entries.zh_cn: Fine-Gray 协变量矩阵行长度不一致。
entries.en_us: Fine-Gray covariate matrix rows have inconsistent lengths.

entries.zh_cn: fine_gray_multi 需要至少两个协变量；单列请用 fine_gray_continuous。
entries.en_us: fine_gray_multi needs at least two covariates; for a single column use fine_gray_continuous.

entries.zh_cn: Fine-Gray 连续协变量长度与观测不一致。
entries.en_us: Fine-Gray continuous covariate length does not match the observation count.

entries.zh_cn: 目标原因失效只出现在一个分组中；估计仍可运行但对比识别较弱。
entries.en_us: Target-cause failures appear in only one group; estimation can still run, but contrast identification is weak.

entries.zh_cn: 已指定多协变量列：Fine-Gray 使用 multi IPCW，不与二分类 group Fine-Gray 同时运行。
entries.en_us: Multiple covariate columns were specified: Fine-Gray uses multi IPCW and does not also run binary-group Fine-Gray.

entries.zh_cn: 已指定连续协变量列：Fine-Gray 使用 continuous IPCW，不与二分类 group Fine-Gray 同时运行。
entries.en_us: A continuous covariate column was specified: Fine-Gray uses continuous IPCW and does not also run binary-group Fine-Gray.

entries.zh_cn: Isolation Forest 需要非空矩阵与 tree_count ≥ 1。
entries.en_us: Isolation Forest requires a non-empty matrix and tree_count ≥ 1.

entries.zh_cn: 至少需要 2 个观测与 2 个变量。
entries.en_us: At least 2 observations and 2 variables are required.

entries.zh_cn: 自研 Isolation Forest；多元异常辅助；非单变量 Grubbs/Dixon；非 TreeNet。
entries.en_us: In-house Isolation Forest; multivariate anomaly aid; not univariate Grubbs/Dixon; not TreeNet.

entries.zh_cn: K-Means 需要至少一行有效数值观测。
entries.en_us: K-Means requires at least one valid numeric observation row.
The number of valid observations must be ≥ k.

entries.zh_cn: 初始质心取前 k 个有效观测（分析尺度）；Lloyd 迭代（分配→更新质心）。
entries.en_us: Initial centroids use the first k valid observations (analysis scale); Lloyd iteration (assign → update centroids).

entries.zh_cn: 已达最大迭代次数，分配可能尚未完全稳定。
entries.en_us: Maximum iterations reached; assignments may not be fully stable.

entries.zh_cn: CART 需要预测矩阵与响应对齐且非空。
entries.en_us: CART requires a non-empty predictor matrix aligned with the response.

entries.zh_cn: 至少需要一个数值预测变量。
entries.en_us: At least one numeric predictor is required.

entries.zh_cn: 有效观测过少，无法按 min_leaf 分裂。
entries.en_us: Too few valid observations to split under min_leaf.

entries.zh_cn: 自研 CART 单树；非 Minitab TreeNet/Random Forests 数值对齐；本轮无成本复杂度剪枝。
entries.en_us: In-house single CART tree; not numerically aligned to Minitab TreeNet/Random Forests; no cost-complexity pruning in this run.

entries.zh_cn: 线性判别需要 ≥2 类、≥1 预测变量与足够观测。
entries.en_us: Linear discriminant needs ≥2 classes, ≥1 predictor, and enough observations.

entries.zh_cn: 类别编码或预测行列不一致。
entries.en_us: Class codes or predictor row/column layout are inconsistent.

entries.zh_cn: 每个类至少需要 2 个观测。
entries.en_us: Each class needs at least 2 observations.

entries.zh_cn: 合并协方差自由度不足。
entries.en_us: Insufficient degrees of freedom for the pooled covariance.

entries.zh_cn: 线性判别（等协方差）；非 Minitab golden；不做 QDA。
entries.en_us: Linear discriminant (equal covariance); not Minitab golden; no QDA.

entries.zh_cn: 层次聚类需要非空矩阵且 k≥2。
entries.en_us: Hierarchical clustering requires a non-empty matrix and k≥2.

entries.zh_cn: Complete linkage + 欧氏距离；非 Minitab golden。
entries.en_us: Complete linkage + Euclidean distance; not Minitab golden.

entries.zh_cn: 观测不足（n<30），无法做二维高斯混合 EM；不得把不足样本写成已排除混合。
entries.en_us: Insufficient observations (n<30) for two-component Gaussian-mixture EM; do not write undersized samples as having ruled out a mixture.

entries.zh_cn: 二维高斯混合 EM 密度退化，未能收敛；不得伪造混合拟合。
entries.en_us: Two-component Gaussian-mixture EM density degenerated and did not converge; do not fabricate a mixture fit.

entries.zh_cn: 二维高斯混合 EM 未在迭代上限内收敛；不得把未收敛结果写成已确认混合。
entries.en_us: Two-component Gaussian-mixture EM did not converge within the iteration limit; do not write a non-converged result as a confirmed mixture.

entries.zh_cn: 观测不足（n<30），无法做多 k 高斯混合 BIC 搜索；不得把不足样本写成已排除混合。
entries.en_us: Insufficient observations (n<30) for multi-k Gaussian-mixture BIC search; do not write undersized samples as having ruled out a mixture.

entries.zh_cn: 多 k 高斯混合 BIC 搜索未得到可用拟合；不得伪造混合结论。
entries.en_us: Multi-k Gaussian-mixture BIC search produced no usable fit; do not fabricate mixture conclusions.

entries.zh_cn: 能力指标未验证过程稳定性和正态性；数值仅供调查，不能单独作为过程合格结论。
entries.en_us: Capability indices have not verified process stability and normality; values are for investigation only and must not stand alone as process pass/fail.

entries.zh_cn: 能力指标未验证过程稳定性；数值仅供调查，不能单独作为过程合格结论。
entries.en_us: Capability indices have not verified process stability; values are for investigation only and must not stand alone as process pass/fail.

entries.zh_cn: 观测不足，无法做能力分析前的 I-MR 稳定性初筛。
entries.en_us: Too few observations for the pre-capability I-MR stability screen.

entries.zh_cn: 观测不足（n<30），无法做能力分析前的双峰直方图初筛；不得把不足样本写成已排除双峰。
entries.en_us: Fewer than 30 observations; bimodality histogram screen cannot run—do not describe an insufficient sample as having ruled out bimodality.

entries.zh_cn: 直方图双峰初筛未检出可分离峰；这不是单峰证明，不得据此开放过程合格判定。
entries.en_us: Histogram bimodality screen found no separable peaks; this does not prove unimodality and must not open process pass/fail.

entries.zh_cn: 能力分析双峰前置：当前为公式参考级直方图峰谷初筛；Hartigan dip 与二维高斯混合另有门禁筛查；合格判定保持关闭。
entries.en_us: Capability bimodality prerequisite: formula-reference histogram peak/valley screen; Hartigan dip and Gaussian mixture are separate gated screens; pass/fail stays closed.

entries.zh_cn: 观测不足（n<8），无法做 Hartigan dip 单峰门禁筛查；不得把不足样本写成已证明单峰。
entries.en_us: Fewer than 8 observations; Hartigan dip unimodality screen cannot run—do not describe an insufficient sample as proving unimodality.

entries.zh_cn: Hartigan dip 门禁筛查未拒绝 Uniform 零假设下的单峰（formula_reference）；这不是过程单峰证明，也不得开放合格判定。
entries.en_us: Hartigan dip gated screen did not reject unimodality under a Uniform null (formula_reference); this is not proof of process unimodality and must not open pass/fail.

entries.zh_cn: 能力分析 Hartigan dip 前置：公式参考级研究筛查（Uniform 零假设 MC）；不是商业软件对齐；二维高斯混合另有门禁；合格判定保持关闭。
entries.en_us: Capability Hartigan dip prerequisite: formula-reference research screen (Uniform-null MC); not commercial-software alignment; Gaussian mixture is a separate gate; pass/fail stays closed.

entries.zh_cn: 观测不足（n<30），无法做多 k 高斯混合门禁；不得把不足样本写成已排除混合。
entries.en_us: Fewer than 30 observations; multi-k Gaussian mixture gate cannot run—do not describe an insufficient sample as having ruled out mixture.

entries.zh_cn: 多 k 高斯混合门禁未得到可用拟合；不得伪造混合结论或开放合格判定。
entries.en_us: Multi-k Gaussian mixture gate did not obtain a usable fit; do not invent a mixture conclusion or open process pass/fail.

entries.zh_cn: 多 k 高斯混合门禁未优选多成分（formula_reference / gaussian_mixture_k_bic）；这不是单峰/单成分证明，也不得开放合格判定。
entries.en_us: Multi-k Gaussian mixture gate did not prefer multiple components (formula_reference / gaussian_mixture_k_bic); this is not proof of unimodality/single-component and must not open pass/fail.

entries.zh_cn: 能力分析混合模型前置：高斯 EM + BIC 搜索 k=1..k_max（formula_reference / gaussian_mixture_k_bic）；不是非高斯混合，不是商业软件对齐，合格判定保持关闭。
entries.en_us: Capability mixture prerequisite: Gaussian EM + BIC search k=1..k_max (formula_reference / gaussian_mixture_k_bic); not non-Gaussian mixtures, not commercial-software alignment; pass/fail stays closed.

entries.zh_cn: Johnson 能力为研究/预览结果：可显示拟合与变换尺度指数，但不得输出过程合格判定（门禁：缺 golden/尾部/人工解释验收）。
entries.en_us: Johnson capability is research/preview only: fit and transform-scale indices may be shown, but process pass/fail judgment is blocked (gate: missing golden / tail / human review).

entries.zh_cn: 正态能力未满足稳定性/正态性验收前置：禁止过程合格判定（pass_fail_judgment_allowed=false）。
entries.en_us: Normal capability has not met the stability/normality acceptance prerequisite: process pass/fail judgment is blocked (pass_fail_judgment_allowed=false).

entries.zh_cn: 规格限落在 Johnson 变换定义域外，无法计算 Pp/Ppk。
entries.en_us: Specification limits fall outside the Johnson transform support; Pp/Ppk cannot be computed.

entries.zh_cn: 至少一个规格限落在变换定义域外；越界侧的百分位回推未实现，仅输出仍可变换规格的 overall 指数。
entries.en_us: At least one specification limit is outside transform support; percentile back-transform for the out-of-support side is not implemented—only overall indices for still-transformable specs are reported.

entries.zh_cn: Johnson 变换路径只报告 overall Pp/Ppk，不报告 within Cp/Cpk。
entries.en_us: The Johnson transform path reports overall Pp/Ppk only; within Cp/Cpk are not reported.

entries.zh_cn: Johnson 变换至少需要 8 个有限观测。
entries.en_us: Johnson transform requires at least 8 finite observations.

entries.zh_cn: 样本量不足以估计 Johnson 分位匹配所需的尾部分位数。
entries.en_us: Sample size is insufficient to estimate the tail quantiles required for Johnson percentile matching.

entries.zh_cn: Johnson 变换按 Chou et al. (1998) 分位匹配与 AD p 值选择；数值是公式参考，不是 Minitab Individual Distribution Identification 导出。
entries.en_us: Johnson transform is selected by Chou et al. (1998) percentile matching and AD p-value; values are formula reference, not a Minitab Individual Distribution Identification export.

entries.zh_cn: 非正态能力使用拟合分布 CDF 的 Z-score 法计算 Pp/Ppk；不报告 Cp/Cpk。数值是公式参考，不是 Minitab 导出。
entries.en_us: Nonnormal capability computes Pp/Ppk via the fitted-distribution CDF Z-score method; Cp/Cpk are not reported. Values are formula reference, not a Minitab export.

entries.zh_cn: Box-Cox 变换至少需要两个有效观测。
entries.en_us: Box-Cox requires at least two valid observations.

entries.en_us: Box-Cox requires all observations strictly greater than 0.

entries.en_us: Upper spec limit cannot be transformed (must be a positive finite value).

entries.en_us: With n<8 the normality approximation is coarse; failure to reject normality must not be treated as verified normality.

entries.zh_cn: 二项过程能力未验证独立性、恒定 p 与稳定性，不能写成过程合格。
entries.en_us: Binomial process capability has not verified independence, constant p, and stability; do not write process pass/fail.

entries.zh_cn: 泊松过程能力未验证独立性、恒定 DPU 与稳定性，不能写成过程合格。
entries.en_us: Poisson process capability has not verified independence, constant DPU, and stability; do not write process pass/fail.

entries.en_us: Parallel coordinates require at least two continuous variables.

entries.en_us: Density estimation requires at least two finite observations.

entries.zh_cn: 二维分箱至少需要两个 complete-case 点。
entries.en_us: 2D binning requires at least two complete-case points.

entries.en_us: Cochran Q did not compute a statistic (e.g. too few columns, encoding failure, or degenerate denominator). Use McNemar for two paired columns; do not write proof that treatment positive rates are the same or different.

entries.en_us: A significant overall F only means at least one group differs; use multiple comparisons to identify pairs.

entries.en_us: Walsh estimated median is %1. A point estimate does not prove equality to the hypothesized value.

entries.en_us: Steel–Dwass (approximate) pairwise comparisons: %1 pair(s); Grouping letters reflect only that rule’s significance matrix and do not prove groups are the same or different.

entries.en_us: Nemenyi (approximate) pairwise comparisons: %1 pair(s); Grouping letters reflect only that rule’s significance matrix and do not prove treatments are the same or different.

entries.en_us: One-sample Wilcoxon signed-rank P = %1. Failure to reject the null does not prove the median equals the hypothesized value; Walsh estimates and intervals describe location only.

entries.en_us: Paired Wilcoxon signed-rank P = %1. Failure to reject the null does not prove the paired-difference median is 0.

entries.en_us: Mood median test χ² = %1, P = %2. Failure to reject the null does not prove group medians are equal; per-group Sign CIs describe within-group location only.

entries.en_us: In-house implementation; not an sklearn runtime; not TreeNet/RF.

entries.en_us: IRLS did not converge; do not give stable interpretations of divergent coefficients.
