entries.zh_cn: 连续 6 点持续单调趋势
entries.en_us: 6 points in a row in a sustained monotonic trend

entries.zh_cn: 调查磨损、漂移或时间相关结构，核对趋势窗口点。
entries.en_us: Investigate wear, drift, or time structure; verify trend-window points.
14 points in a row alternating up and down

entries.zh_cn: 调查周期、交替作业或过度调整，核对交替窗口。
entries.en_us: Investigate cycles, alternating operations, or over-adjustment; verify the alternating window.

entries.zh_cn: 3 点中至少 2 点同侧超过 2σ
entries.en_us: At least 2 of 3 points beyond 2σ on the same side

entries.zh_cn: 调查较小系统性偏移，核对命中点标准化距离。
entries.en_us: Investigate a smaller systematic shift; verify standardized distances of hits.

entries.zh_cn: 5 点中至少 4 点同侧超过 1σ
entries.en_us: At least 4 of 5 points beyond 1σ on the same side

entries.zh_cn: 调查过程均值小幅移动，核对命中点标准化距离。
entries.en_us: Investigate a small process-mean move; verify standardized distances of hits.

entries.zh_cn: 连续 15 点全部落在 1σ 内
entries.en_us: 15 points in a row all within 1σ

entries.zh_cn: 调查控制限是否过宽或数据分层，核对 σ 来源。
entries.en_us: Investigate whether limits are too wide or data are stratified; verify the σ source.

entries.zh_cn: 连续 8 点全部位于 1σ 外且同侧
entries.en_us: 8 points in a row beyond 1σ on the same side

entries.zh_cn: 调查混合总体或双群模式，按分组/批次复核。
entries.en_us: Investigate mixed populations or dual clusters; review by group/lot.

entries.zh_cn: y < LCL 或 y > UCL（严格）
任一点低于 LCL 或高于 UCL；有限控制限使用严格越界比较。表示该点与当前控制模型不一致，不等于根因已确认。
entries.en_us: Any point below LCL or above UCL; finite limits use a strict beyond-limit comparison. Means the point disagrees with the current control model, not that a root cause is confirmed.

entries.zh_cn: 全部位于中心线同一侧（中心线上点打断）
entries.en_us: All on the same side of the center line (on-center points break the run)

entries.zh_cn: 连续 9 个可用点全部在中心线同一侧；跨缺失或阶段断点不形成窗口。提示均值偏移、分层或阶段变化。
entries.en_us: Nine consecutive usable points all on the same side of the center line; missing or stage breaks do not form a window. Suggests mean shift, stratification, or stage change.

entries.zh_cn: 严格递增或严格递减（相等打断）
entries.en_us: Strictly increasing or decreasing (ties break the run)

entries.zh_cn: 连续 6 点严格递增或严格递减；相等值不构成趋势。提示磨损、漂移或时间相关结构。
entries.en_us: Six consecutive points strictly increasing or decreasing; equal values do not form a trend. Suggests wear, drift, or time structure.

entries.zh_cn: 相邻差分符号交替（零差分打断）
entries.en_us: Adjacent difference signs alternate (zero differences break the run)

entries.zh_cn: 连续 14 点相邻差值符号严格交替；零差值打断规则。提示周期、人机/设备交替或过度调整。
entries.en_us: Fourteen consecutive points with strictly alternating adjacent-difference signs; zero differences break the rule. Suggests cycles, alternating ops, or over-adjustment.
Same side and |y−CL| > 2σ, at least 2 points

entries.zh_cn: 3 点窗口内至少 2 点位于中心线同侧且距离严格大于 2σ；提示较小但系统性的偏移。
entries.en_us: In a 3-point window, at least 2 points are on the same side of the center line and strictly beyond 2σ; suggests a smaller systematic shift.
Same side and |y−CL| > 1σ, at least 4 points

entries.zh_cn: 5 点窗口内至少 4 点位于同侧且距离严格大于 1σ；提示过程均值发生小幅移动。
entries.en_us: In a 5-point window, at least 4 points are on the same side and strictly beyond 1σ; suggests a small process-mean move.

entries.zh_cn: 连续 15 个点的绝对中心线距离严格小于 σ；提示控制限可能过宽或数据存在分层。
entries.en_us: Fifteen consecutive points with absolute center-line distance strictly less than σ; suggests limits may be too wide or data are stratified.

entries.zh_cn: 连续 8 点均在中心线同一侧且绝对距离严格大于 σ；提示混合总体或双群模式。
entries.en_us: Eight consecutive points on the same side of the center line with absolute distance strictly greater than σ; suggests mixed populations or dual clusters.

entries.zh_cn: 规则未启用，本次分析未验证该特殊原因模式。
entries.en_us: Rule not enabled; this special-cause pattern was not verified in this analysis.

entries.zh_cn: 没有可绘制的控制图点，无法判定规则。
entries.en_us: No plottable control-chart points; rule cannot be evaluated.

entries.zh_cn: 此规则不适用于控制图类型
entries.en_us: This rule does not apply to control chart type

entries.zh_cn: 特殊原因策略 = %1（多规则提高灵敏度也提高误报风险）
entries.en_us: Special-cause policy = %1 (more rules raise sensitivity and false-alarm risk)

entries.zh_cn: 特殊原因策略 = %1（默认接近 Minitab 仅「单点超出 3σ 控制限」）
entries.en_us: Special-cause policy = %1 (defaults near Minitab: only '1 point beyond 3σ limits')

entries.zh_cn: 效应 Pareto 最大项为 %1；参考线方法为 %2。条越过参考线只提供统计证据，不表示过程合格。
entries.en_us: Largest Pareto effect term is %1; reference-line method is %2. Crossing the reference line is statistical evidence only and does not mean process pass/fail.

entries.zh_cn: 等值线/曲面轴为 %1 与 %2。
等值线/曲面轴为 %1 与 %2；其余因子编码 hold=0：%3。
entries.en_us: Contour/surface axes are %1 and %2; other factors held at coded 0: %3.

entries.zh_cn: 等值线/曲面轴为 %1 与 %2；其余因子实际单位 hold：%3。
entries.en_us: Contour/surface axes are %1 and %2; other factors held at actual units: %3.

entries.zh_cn: 等值线/曲面按前两因子绘制，其余因子编码 hold=0；用于探索响应形状。
entries.en_us: Contour/surface uses the first two factors; other factors held at coded 0; for exploring response shape.

entries.zh_cn: 设计类型 = %1；运行数 = %2%3。可将设计矩阵写入工作表后用 DOE 响应分析衔接。
entries.en_us: Design type = %1; run count = %2%3. After writing the design matrix to a worksheet, continue with DOE response analysis.

entries.zh_cn: 生成器：%1。别名结构仅说明混淆模式，不是显著性结论。
entries.en_us: Generators: %1. Alias structure describes confounding patterns only and is not a significance conclusion.

entries.zh_cn: 多响应 Desirability 优化覆盖 %1 个响应（%2）；总体 D 为几何平均。
entries.en_us: Multi-response desirability optimization covers %1 response(s) (%2); overall D is the geometric mean.

entries.zh_cn: 最佳候选总体 Desirability = %1；这是在编码 ±1 设计空间内枚举得到的结果。
entries.en_us: Best candidate overall desirability = %1; obtained by enumeration inside the coded ±1 design space.

entries.zh_cn: 响应优化在编码 ±1 空间枚举候选组合；结果不能外推到设计空间之外。
entries.en_us: Response optimization enumerates candidates in coded ±1 space; results must not be extrapolated outside the design space.

entries.zh_cn: 多响应冲突时优先核对各响应 Desirability 与权重；确认性试验应覆盖总体 D 靠前且工程上可实施的组合。
entries.en_us: When responses conflict, reconcile each desirability and weights first; confirmation trials should cover high overall-D combinations that are engineering-feasible.

entries.zh_cn: RSM 二次模型（编码单位）：因子数 = %1；项数 = %2%3。
entries.en_us: RSM quadratic model (coded units): factor count = %1; term count = %2%3.

entries.zh_cn: 当前 |t| 最大项 = %1（仅描述相对大小，不是工程最优）。
entries.en_us: Largest |t| term currently = %1 (relative magnitude only; not an engineering optimum).

entries.zh_cn: 设计来源 ID = %1%2；编码模式 = %3。
失拟检验可用（纯误差 DF = %1；失拟 DF = %2%3）；证据类型 formula_reference，不是 vendor_oracle。
entries.en_us: Lack-of-fit test available (pure-error DF = %1; lack-of-fit DF = %2%3); evidence type formula_reference, not vendor_oracle.

entries.zh_cn: EWMA 仅启用「单点超出 3σ 控制限」；其余特殊原因规则不适用，超限点需结合原始观测调查。
entries.en_us: EWMA enables only '1 point beyond 3σ limits'; other special-cause rules do not apply—investigate out-of-control points with raw observations.

entries.zh_cn: CUSUM 使用累计和决策间隔信号，不套用 Shewhart 特殊原因规则（beyond_control_limit 等）；信号点需结合原始行调查，不是删点指令。
entries.en_us: CUSUM uses cumulative-sum decision-interval signals and does not apply Shewhart special-cause rules (e.g. beyond_control_limit); investigate signal points in source rows—this is not a delete-points instruction.

entries.zh_cn: 未发现当前规则能够自动判定的异常；请结合现场工艺、规格要求和图表进行确认。
entries.en_us: No anomaly was auto-flagged by the current rules; confirm with process knowledge, specifications, and charts.

entries.zh_cn: 将统计结果与规格、风险等级、历史基线和现场特殊原因结合后再采取措施。
entries.en_us: Combine statistical results with specifications, risk level, historical baselines, and field special causes before taking action.

entries.zh_cn: 组内 σ = %1。这些标准差只描述当前子组分解，不是规格判定。
entries.en_us: Within σ = %1. These SDs describe the current subgroup decomposition only and are not a specification decision.

entries.zh_cn: 组内 σ = %1（%2）。这些标准差只描述当前子组分解，不是规格判定。
entries.en_us: Within σ = %1 (%2). These SDs describe the current subgroup decomposition only and are not a specification decision.

entries.zh_cn: 组内 σ = %1，组间 σ = %2。这些标准差只描述当前子组分解，不是规格判定。
entries.en_us: Within σ = %1, between σ = %2. These SDs describe the current subgroup decomposition only and are not a specification decision.

entries.zh_cn: 组内 σ = %1，组间 σ = %2（%3）。这些标准差只描述当前子组分解，不是规格判定。
entries.en_us: Within σ = %1, between σ = %2 (%3). These SDs describe the current subgroup decomposition only and are not a specification decision.

entries.zh_cn: 组内 σ = %1，σ_BW = %2。这些标准差只描述当前子组分解，不是规格判定。
entries.en_us: Within σ = %1, σ_BW = %2. These SDs describe the current subgroup decomposition only and are not a specification decision.

entries.zh_cn: 组内 σ = %1，σ_BW = %2（%3）。这些标准差只描述当前子组分解，不是规格判定。
entries.en_us: Within σ = %1, σ_BW = %2 (%3). These SDs describe the current subgroup decomposition only and are not a specification decision.

entries.zh_cn: 组内 σ = %1，组间 σ = %2，σ_BW = %3。这些标准差只描述当前子组分解，不是规格判定。
entries.en_us: Within σ = %1, between σ = %2, σ_BW = %3. These SDs describe the current subgroup decomposition only and are not a specification decision.

entries.zh_cn: 组内 σ = %1，组间 σ = %2，σ_BW = %3（%4）。这些标准差只描述当前子组分解，不是规格判定。
entries.en_us: Within σ = %1, between σ = %2, σ_BW = %3 (%4). These SDs describe the current subgroup decomposition only and are not a specification decision.

entries.zh_cn: 单样本 Z 检验（已知 σ%1）%2%3%4。P 值与置信区间只描述当前样本证据，统计显著不等于工程差异具有实际重要性，也不是过程合格判定。
entries.en_us: One-sample Z test (known σ%1)%2%3%4. P-values and CIs describe sample evidence only; statistical significance is not engineering importance and not a process pass/fail decision.

entries.zh_cn: 双样本 t 检验（%1）%2%3。P 值与置信区间只描述当前样本证据，统计显著不等于工程差异具有实际重要性，也不是过程合格判定。
entries.en_us: Two-sample t test (%1)%2%3. P-values and CIs describe sample evidence only; statistical significance is not engineering importance and not a process pass/fail decision.

entries.zh_cn: 配对 t 检验%1%2。P 值与置信区间只描述当前样本证据，统计显著不等于工程差异具有实际重要性，也不是过程合格判定。
entries.en_us: Paired t test%1%2. P-values and CIs describe sample evidence only; statistical significance is not engineering importance and not a process pass/fail decision.

entries.zh_cn: 单样本 t 检验%1%2。P 值与置信区间只描述当前样本证据，统计显著不等于工程差异具有实际重要性，也不是过程合格判定。
entries.en_us: One-sample t test%1%2. P-values and CIs describe sample evidence only; statistical significance is not engineering importance and not a process pass/fail decision.

entries.zh_cn: Z 检验要求已知总体标准差且正态/大样本近似成立（assumption_status=%1）；样本 StDev 仅展示，不参与 Z/CI。
entries.en_us: Z test requires known population SD and normality/large-sample approximation (assumption_status=%1); sample StDev is display-only and does not enter Z/CI.

entries.zh_cn: t 检验正态与独立假设未验证（assumption_status=%1）。
entries.en_us: t-test normality and independence assumptions are unverified (assumption_status=%1).

entries.zh_cn: %1 正态性检验判定为 %2%3%4。在 alpha 下未拒绝正态假设，不能写成数据已正态。
entries.en_us: %1 normality test decision is %2%3%4. Failure to reject normality at alpha does not prove the data are normal.

entries.zh_cn: %1 正态性检验判定为 %2%3%4。证据反对正态假设，这不是规格判定。
entries.en_us: %1 normality test decision is %2%3%4. Evidence against normality is not a specification decision.

entries.zh_cn: %1 正态性检验判定为 %2%3%4。统计量未计算，不能写成数据已正态。
entries.en_us: %1 normality test decision is %2%3%4. Statistics were not computed; do not claim the data are normal.

entries.zh_cn: %Defective = %1（Average P = %2）。这是当前样本的不合格品率估计，不是过程合格判定。
entries.en_us: %Defective = %1 (Average P = %2). This estimates the current sample defective rate and is not a process pass/fail decision.

entries.zh_cn: Process Z = %1，由 Average P 的标准正态右尾得到。
entries.en_us: Process Z = %1, obtained from the standard-normal right tail of Average P.

entries.zh_cn: Mean DPU = %1。这是当前样本的单位缺陷率估计，不是过程合格判定。
entries.en_us: Mean DPU = %1. This estimates the current sample defects-per-unit rate and is not a process pass/fail decision.

entries.zh_cn: 二项过程能力未验证独立性、恒定 p 与稳定性（assumption_status=%1），不能写成过程合格。
entries.en_us: Binomial capability did not verify independence, constant p, or stability (assumption_status=%1); do not claim process pass.

entries.zh_cn: 泊松过程能力未验证独立性、恒定 DPU 与稳定性（assumption_status=%1），不能写成过程合格。
entries.en_us: Poisson capability did not verify independence, constant DPU, or stability (assumption_status=%1); do not claim process pass.

entries.zh_cn: %1%2%3。在 α 下拒绝“无异常值”假设，嫌疑观测需工程调查，P 值只描述与正态假设下的一致性，勿当作删点依据，也勿当成异常已核实。
entries.en_us: %1%2%3. At α, reject the no-outlier hypothesis; investigate suspect observations—P only describes consistency under normality and is not a delete-points warrant or confirmed anomaly.

entries.zh_cn: %1%2%3。未拒绝“无异常值”假设，不能证明数据中没有异常值。
entries.en_us: %1%2%3. Failure to reject the no-outlier hypothesis does not prove the data contain no outliers.

entries.zh_cn: Dixon r10 要求近似正态、至多一个异常值，且 P 可能为临界值插值近似（assumption_status=%1）。
entries.en_us: Dixon r10 assumes approximate normality and at most one outlier; P may be a critical-value interpolation (assumption_status=%1).

entries.zh_cn: Grubbs 要求近似正态且至多一个异常值（assumption_status=%1）。
entries.en_us: Grubbs requires approximate normality and at most one outlier (assumption_status=%1).

entries.zh_cn: Pearson 相关系数表示变量关联方向与强度；P-Value 反映在零相关假设下的证据强度，不能单独证明因果关系。未拒绝零相关不能写成已证明无关。
entries.en_us: Pearson correlation describes association direction and strength; the P-value reflects evidence under zero correlation and alone cannot prove causation. Failure to reject zero correlation does not prove independence.

entries.zh_cn: Spearman 相关系数表示变量关联方向与强度；P-Value 反映在零相关假设下的证据强度，不能单独证明因果关系。未拒绝零相关不能写成已证明无关。
entries.en_us: Spearman correlation describes association direction and strength; the P-value reflects evidence under zero correlation and alone cannot prove causation. Failure to reject zero correlation does not prove independence.

entries.zh_cn: 相关分析使用 complete-case 对齐（N = %1），assumption_status=%2。
协方差矩阵基于 complete-case 样本协方差；对角线为各变量方差。
entries.en_us: The covariance matrix is complete-case sample covariance; the diagonal is each variable's variance.

entries.zh_cn: 偏相关在控制其余变量后给出 Pearson 偏系数；不能写成已排除混杂或已证明因果。
entries.en_us: Partial correlation gives Pearson partial coefficients after controlling other variables; do not claim confounders are removed or causation is proven.

entries.zh_cn: 相关系数表示变量关联方向与强度；P-Value 反映在零相关假设下观察到当前系数的证据强度，不能单独证明因果关系。
entries.en_us: Correlation describes association direction and strength; the P-value reflects evidence for the observed coefficient under zero correlation and alone cannot prove causation.

entries.zh_cn: 二项 OC 曲线描述在 n=%1、c=%2 计划下，不同不合格品率 p 的接收概率 Pa(p)；OC 用于评估抽样方案风险，不能替代对具体批次的接收判定。
entries.en_us: The binomial OC curve gives acceptance probability Pa(p) for plan n=%1, c=%2 across defective rates p; OC assesses sampling-plan risk and does not replace lot disposition decisions.

entries.zh_cn: Pa(AQL) = %1 只反映 AQL 风险点，不是生产判定结论。
entries.en_us: Pa(AQL) = %1 reflects the AQL risk point only and is not a production disposition conclusion.

entries.zh_cn: Pa(RQL) = %1 只反映 RQL 风险点，不是拒收证明。
entries.en_us: Pa(RQL) = %1 reflects the RQL risk point only and is not proof of rejection.

entries.zh_cn: 批大小 N = %1 仅作摘要；本轮 OC 仍用二项（无限批）近似。
entries.en_us: Lot size N = %1 is summary only; this OC still uses a binomial (infinite-lot) approximation.

entries.zh_cn: 等价性检验比较%1与界限 [%2, %3]%4，区间落在等价界限内。%5这只陈述界限关系，不能写成已证明等价。
entries.en_us: Equivalence testing compares %1 to limits [%2, %3]%4; the interval falls inside the equivalence limits. %5This states a limit relationship only and does not prove equivalence.

entries.zh_cn: 等价性检验比较%1与界限 [%2, %3]%4，区间未落入等价界限内。%5这只陈述界限关系，不能写成已证明等价。
entries.en_us: Equivalence testing compares %1 to limits [%2, %3]%4; the interval does not fall inside the equivalence limits. %5This states a limit relationship only and does not prove equivalence.

entries.zh_cn: ANOM 在 α=%1 下比较各组均值与总体均值；超出 UDL/LDL 的组数 = %2。这标记值得进一步调查的组，不能写成组间无差异或应剔除该组。
entries.en_us: ANOM at α=%1 compares group means to the overall mean; groups beyond UDL/LDL = %2. This flags groups for investigation and does not prove no differences or that a group should be removed.

entries.zh_cn: 决策限方法 = %1（正态近似）；二项/泊松计数不适用本命令。
entries.en_us: Decision-limit method = %1 (normal approximation); binomial/Poisson counts are not for this command.

entries.zh_cn: ANOVA 的总体 F 检验显著时，只能说明至少存在一组均值差异；需要后续多重比较确定具体组对。
entries.en_us: A significant overall ANOVA F only indicates at least one mean difference; follow-up multiple comparisons are needed to identify pairs.

entries.zh_cn: 请结合 P-Value 与均值差置信区间判断差异；统计显著不等于工程差异具有实际重要性。
entries.en_us: Interpret differences using the P-value and the mean-difference CI; statistical significance is not engineering importance.

entries.zh_cn: 响应优化在编码 ±1 空间枚举候选组合；缺协方差时置信/预测区间不可用，最佳组合不能外推到设计空间之外。
entries.en_us: Response optimization enumerates candidates in coded ±1 space; without covariance, confidence/prediction intervals are unavailable and the best combination must not be extrapolated outside the design space.

entries.zh_cn: 两比例检验方法为 %1，p̂1 = %2，p̂2 = %3%4%5%6。P 值只描述两组比例差异的证据强度，不是规格判定。
entries.en_us: Two-proportion test method is %1, p̂1 = %2, p̂2 = %3%4%5%6. P-values describe evidence for a proportion difference only and are not a specification decision.

entries.zh_cn: 单比例检验方法为 %1%2，p̂ = %3%4%5。P 值只描述与假设比例的证据强度，不是规格判定。
entries.en_us: One-proportion test method is %1%2, p̂ = %3%4%5. The P-value describes evidence versus the hypothesized proportion only and is not a specification decision.

entries.zh_cn: 比例假设未验证独立性与恒定 p（assumption_status=%1）。
entries.en_us: Proportion assumptions did not verify independence or constant p (assumption_status=%1).

entries.zh_cn: 双样本泊松率方法为 %1%2%3。P 值只描述与假设发生率的证据强度，不是规格判定。

entries.en_us: Capability stability prerequisite: only formula-reference I-MR Rule-1 screening is applied; pass/fail stays closed until an independent stability and normality acceptance workflow lands.

entries.zh_cn: 无重复编码点：未报告纯误差/失拟；不得用残差 MS 冒充纯误差。
entries.en_us: No replicated coded points: pure error / lack of fit not reported; residual MS must not be presented as pure error.

entries.zh_cn: 在当前显著性水平下，没有发现可报告为显著的 DOE 项。
entries.en_us: At the current significance level, no DOE terms are reportable as significant.

entries.zh_cn: 未配置中心点，无法用中心点直接检验曲率；二水平线性模型的适用范围有限。
entries.en_us: No center points were configured, so curvature cannot be tested directly via center points; a two-level linear model has limited scope.

entries.zh_cn: Kaplan-Meier 生存表为空，不能估计生存曲线或中位寿命。
entries.en_us: Kaplan-Meier survival table is empty; the survival curve or median life cannot be estimated.

entries.zh_cn: 存在右删失；尾部生存率由较少的风险集支持，不能把删失时间当作失效时间。
entries.en_us: Right censoring is present; tail survival is supported by a thinner risk set—do not treat censoring times as failures.

entries.zh_cn: 按目标任务时间读取生存概率，并报告置信区间；需要比较产品/方案时使用分层或组间检验。
entries.en_us: Read survival probability at the target mission time and report confidence intervals; use stratified or between-group tests when comparing products/plans.

entries.zh_cn: Weibull 参数缺失，不能解释失效率随时间的变化。
entries.en_us: Weibull parameters are missing; the time pattern of the failure rate cannot be interpreted.

entries.zh_cn: Weibull 参数未收敛，分位寿命不能作为决策依据。
entries.en_us: Weibull parameters did not converge; percentile life must not be used for decisions.

entries.zh_cn: 指数模型估计的是恒定失效率假设下的寿命分布。
entries.en_us: The exponential model estimates a lifetime distribution under a constant hazard assumption.

entries.zh_cn: 指数模型不能描述随时间上升或下降的失效率；应与 Weibull 等模型比较适配性。
entries.en_us: The exponential model cannot describe rising or falling hazard over time; compare fit with Weibull and other models.

entries.zh_cn: 报告模型参数和删失处理，并用现场失效机理验证模型假设；不要把分位寿命当成单件保证寿命。
entries.en_us: Report model parameters and censoring handling, and validate assumptions with field failure mechanisms; do not treat percentile life as a unit warranty life.

entries.zh_cn: 不得把统计预测写成法律/质量承诺；分母与时间窗口必须一并阅读。
entries.en_us: Do not write statistical forecasts as legal/quality commitments; denominators and time windows must be read together.

entries.zh_cn: 不是 vendor_oracle；不得写成商业软件对齐。
entries.en_us: Not vendor_oracle; do not claim commercial-software alignment.

entries.zh_cn: （研究/预览指数；门禁禁止写成过程合格判定）。
entries.en_us: (research/preview indices; gate forbids writing process pass/fail).

entries.zh_cn: （非正态/变换路径；禁止写成过程合格判定）。
entries.en_us: (nonnormal/transform path; do not write process pass/fail).

entries.zh_cn: 不得写成过程合格（非混合模型 / 非 Hartigan dip）。
entries.en_us: Do not write process pass/fail (not a mixture fit / not Hartigan dip).

entries.zh_cn: 不得写成过程合格（直方图初筛 ≠ 混合模型证明）。
entries.en_us: Do not write process pass/fail (histogram screen ≠ mixture-model proof).

entries.zh_cn: 双峰初筛为 suspected：单一分布能力指数仅供调查，不得写成过程合格（直方图初筛 ≠ 混合模型证明）。
entries.en_us: Bimodality screen is suspected: single-distribution capability indices are for investigation only; do not write process pass/fail (histogram screen ≠ mixture-model proof).

entries.zh_cn: Hartigan dip 为 evidence_against：单一分布能力指数仅供调查，不得写成过程合格（formula_reference；非 vendor_oracle）。
entries.en_us: Hartigan dip is evidence_against: single-distribution capability indices are for investigation only; do not write process pass/fail (formula_reference; not vendor_oracle).

entries.zh_cn: 二维高斯混合为 preferred_2comp：单一分布能力指数仅供调查，不得写成过程合格（formula_reference / gaussian_mixture_k_bic；非 vendor_oracle）。
entries.en_us: Two-component Gaussian mixture is preferred_2comp: single-distribution capability indices are for investigation only; do not write process pass/fail (formula_reference / gaussian_mixture_k_bic; not vendor_oracle).

entries.zh_cn: 高斯混合为 preferred_kcomp（k=%1）：单一分布能力指数仅供调查，不得写成过程合格（formula_reference / gaussian_mixture_k_bic；非 vendor_oracle）。
entries.en_us: Gaussian mixture is preferred_kcomp (k=%1): single-distribution capability indices are for investigation only; do not write process pass/fail (formula_reference / gaussian_mixture_k_bic; not vendor_oracle).

entries.zh_cn: 未满足 golden/尾部验收前不得开放合格判定。
entries.en_us: Do not open pass/fail until golden and tail acceptance are satisfied.

entries.zh_cn: 未验证稳定性不等于过程合格。
entries.en_us: Unverified stability is not process pass/fail.

entries.zh_cn: ndc 不可估计，不能据此评价测量系统分辨力。
entries.en_us: ndc is not estimable; measurement-system discrimination cannot be judged from it.

entries.zh_cn: ndc 不可估计；不能据此评价测量系统分辨力。
entries.en_us: ndc cannot be estimated; do not judge measurement-system discrimination from it.

entries.zh_cn: 先检查零总变异、零 Gage 标准差或无效容差后再解释 ndc。
entries.en_us: Check zero total variation, zero Gage SD, or invalid tolerance before interpreting ndc.

entries.zh_cn: ndc < 5，提示测量系统对零件间差异的分辨力需要调查。
entries.en_us: ndc < 5 suggests investigating discrimination versus part-to-part variation.

entries.zh_cn: ndc 小于 5 只是调查提示，不是量具不合格的绝对结论。
entries.en_us: ndc below 5 is an investigation hint only, not an absolute gage-fail conclusion.

entries.zh_cn: ndc ≥ 5；这只说明当前研究中零件间变异相对 Gage 变异较大。
entries.en_us: ndc ≥ 5 only means part variation is large relative to Gage variation in this study.

entries.zh_cn: 仍需结合 %Study Var、%Tolerance 和现场公差风险解释。
entries.en_us: Still interpret with %Study Var, %Tolerance, and field tolerance risk.

entries.zh_cn: 交叉设计单元重复次数平衡。
entries.en_us: Crossed-design cell replicate counts are balanced.

entries.zh_cn: 平衡设计是 ANOVA 方差分量解释的前提。
entries.en_us: Balance is a prerequisite for interpreting ANOVA variance components.

entries.zh_cn: 零件×操作员单元重复次数不一致。
entries.en_us: Part×operator cell replicate counts are inconsistent.

entries.zh_cn: 交叉设计需要平衡重复后才能解释方差分量。
entries.en_us: Balance replicates in the crossed design before interpreting variance components.

entries.zh_cn: 嵌套设计零件重复次数不一致。
entries.en_us: Nested-design part replicate counts are inconsistent.

entries.zh_cn: 先补齐平衡重复后再解释方差分量。
entries.en_us: Balance replicates before interpreting variance components.

entries.zh_cn: 嵌套设计在操作员和零件重复上平衡。
entries.en_us: Nested design is balanced across operators and part replicates.

entries.zh_cn: 每个零件只属于一个操作员，且重复次数应一致。
entries.en_us: Each part belongs to one operator, and replicate counts should match.

entries.zh_cn: 存在负方差分量，已截断为 0。
entries.en_us: Negative variance components were truncated to 0.

entries.zh_cn: 解释 %Contribution 时同时查看截断前的原始方差分量。
entries.en_us: When interpreting %Contribution, also review pre-truncation variance components.

entries.zh_cn: 交互项 p>0.25，可考虑缩减，但当前保留完整模型。
entries.en_us: Interaction p>0.25; reduction may be considered, but the full model is retained.

entries.zh_cn: 当前保留 Part×Operator 交互模型。
entries.en_us: The Part×Operator interaction model is retained.

entries.zh_cn: 交互是否缩减必须回显；本实现不自动并入重复性。
entries.en_us: Whether interaction is reduced must be reported; this implementation does not fold it into repeatability.

entries.zh_cn: 存在负方差分量，已截断为 0，并保留原始估计。
entries.en_us: Negative variance components were truncated to 0; original estimates are retained.

entries.zh_cn: 方差分量原始估计均非负。
entries.en_us: All raw variance-component estimates are non-negative.

entries.zh_cn: 截断后的分量用于 %Contribution；解释时同时查看原始值。
entries.en_us: Truncated components feed %Contribution; also review the original estimates.

entries.zh_cn: %Contribution 基于方差，%Study Var 基于标准差，口径不同。
entries.en_us: %Contribution is variance-based; %Study Var is SD-based—different bases.

entries.zh_cn: 不要把 %Contribution 与 %Study Var 当成同一个百分比。
entries.en_us: Do not treat %Contribution and %Study Var as the same percentage.

entries.zh_cn: 未提供有效公差，%Tolerance 不可用。
entries.en_us: No valid tolerance was provided; %Tolerance is unavailable.

entries.zh_cn: 只有有限正公差才能计算 %Tolerance。
entries.en_us: Only a finite positive tolerance allows %Tolerance.

entries.zh_cn: 拒绝 Kappa=0 不等于已证明评估者一致。
entries.en_us: Rejecting Kappa=0 does not prove rater agreement.

entries.zh_cn: Kappa 只描述超出偶然的绝对一致率，不能写成测量系统合格。
entries.en_us: Kappa describes chance-corrected absolute agreement only—not MSA pass/fail.

entries.zh_cn: Weighted Kappa 是 DataLab 可选 Cohen 加权，不是 Minitab AAA 默认输出。
entries.en_us: Weighted Kappa is DataLab's optional Cohen weighting, not Minitab AAA default output.

entries.zh_cn: Minitab 有序评级路径使用 Kendall；不要把加权 κ 写成 Minitab AAA 结果。
entries.en_us: Minitab ordinal paths use Kendall; do not report weighted κ as Minitab AAA.

entries.zh_cn: 有序评级已计算 Kendall W/τ；拒绝系数为 0 不等于已证明有序一致。
entries.en_us: Ordinal ratings computed Kendall W/τ; rejecting zero coefficient does not prove ordinal agreement.

entries.zh_cn: 已请求有序评级，但 Kendall 不可识别或等级不足。
entries.en_us: Ordinal ratings were requested, but Kendall is not identifiable or levels are insufficient.

entries.zh_cn: 不要把 Kendall 写成加权 Kappa，也不要把未拒绝原假设写成已证明一致。
entries.en_us: Do not call Kendall weighted Kappa, and do not treat failure to reject as proven agreement.

entries.zh_cn: ndc = truncate(1.41×PartStDev/GageStDev)，<5 只作调查提示。
N-p-1 必须为正才能输出 t、F 与 P。
entries.en_us: N-p-1 must be positive to output t, F, and P.

entries.zh_cn: 设计矩阵秩亏时拒绝拟合，不输出伪造推断。
entries.en_us: Reject fit when the design matrix is rank-deficient; do not emit fabricated inference.

entries.zh_cn: Anderson-Darling 只能拒绝或未拒绝正态假设。
entries.en_us: Anderson-Darling can only reject or fail to reject normality.

entries.zh_cn: Durbin-Watson 对照 α=0.05 近似 dL/dU 判定区；不能写成已证明无自相关。
entries.en_us: Durbin-Watson uses α=0.05 approximate dL/dU zones; cannot be written as proof of no autocorrelation.

entries.zh_cn: 残差对拟合值图是主要证据，不单独宣称已验证。
entries.en_us: Residuals vs fitted plot is primary evidence; do not claim verified homoscedasticity alone.

entries.zh_cn: 杠杆值 > 2p/n 时标记为需要调查的高杠杆点。
entries.en_us: Flag points with leverage > 2p/n for investigation.

entries.zh_cn: |删除学生化残差| > 3 时标记为异常点调查。
entries.en_us: Flag |deleted studentized residual| > 3 for outlier investigation.

entries.zh_cn: Cook's D > 4/n 或 |DFITS| 超过阈值时标记影响点。
entries.en_us: Flag influence when Cook's D > 4/n or |DFITS| exceeds threshold.

entries.zh_cn: VIF > 5 提示共线性调查，不自动删除变量。
entries.en_us: VIF > 5 suggests collinearity investigation; do not auto-drop predictors.

entries.zh_cn: 秩亏或无误差自由度时不输出伪造 F/P。
entries.en_us: Do not emit fabricated F/P when rank-deficient or no error df.

entries.zh_cn: 用残差 Anderson-Darling 作为假设证据。
entries.en_us: Use residual Anderson-Darling as assumption evidence.
